DDN example gallery

Full notation coverage for Diagram Design Notation 0.7.0: 98 installed profiles across 12 projection kinds, 92 variation renders, and the complete example corpus (101 example files) — 291 SVGs, each produced by the reference CLI render path. This page is also the examples index: every runnable .ddn source the project ships is rendered below with its explanation, source and deep links.

Static page: every diagram is a pre-rendered SVG; no runtime is inlined, so this page works from file://. Open Explanation, DDN source & links under any figure for what the diagram shows, its browsable DDN source, a wiki page for the diagram type, and deep links that open the exact view in the unified tool (viewer or designer mode — multi-file examples open their verified combined single-file variant there). Flow animation is part of the live renders: open any flow view in the tool and use its animation drawer, for example the adaptive flow lab.

Sections: Profiles Chart marks Looks × palettes Routing × look Layout algorithms Spacing levels Isometric charts Isometric graph Example corpus Projection kinds DDN sources Coverage table

Variation sheets

Chart marks

Every chart mark the runtime renders: bar, line, area, point, pie, donut (chart.basic@1); radar, funnel, gauge, candlestick, treemap, sankey (their own profiles); and the Category-2 pack (B1-024): histogram, density, qq, quantiledot, dotplot, boxplot, violin, beeswarm, topk, tidytree, radialtree, circlepack, sunburst, packedbubble, heatmap, densityheatmap, calendar, parallelcoords, wordcloud, arc, force, edgebundle; and the isometric variants of the extrudable marks (B1-035): iso bar, pie, donut, area, treemap — plus an iso multi-series grouped bar (B1-036).

Looks × palettes

Every look (classic, handDrawn, neo) crossed with every palette theme (default, neutral, dark, night, forest, base).

Routing × look

Every routing mode (orthogonal, straight, curved bezier, curved rounded) crossed with every look.

Layout algorithms

Every placement algorithm: native grid, manual (pinned), layered, tree, mindmap, grouped, and the pattern-based fit_grid, circular, radial, spanning_tree, organic.

Spacing levels

The four spacing hints (tight, normal, loose, expanded) on one graph (B1-008).

Isometric charts

Every extrudable chart mark (bar, pie, donut, area, treemap) with iso depth, plus a multi-series grouped bar on the quality-render path (B1-036), from examples/basics/72-iso-charts.ddn (B1-034).

Isometric graph

Graph nodes as extruded prisms on an isometric ground plane, from examples/basics/73-iso-architecture.ddn (B1-034).

Example corpus (101)

Every view-bearing example file under website/examples/ — the 101 sources the retired examples index listed — rendered on its first view with the same detail treatment as the profiles above. Files declaring several views note them in their detail block; open the deep link and switch views in the tool. Combined single-file variants (.combined.ddn) of multi-file examples are covered by their original's detail block, and the gallery/src/ sheet sources by the variation sheets above. Library files with no views of their own (imported by other examples, nothing to render): website/examples/projections/formats.ddn website/examples/projections/model.ddn website/examples/quality/details.ddn website/examples/quality/formats.ddn website/examples/quality/model.ddn website/examples/use-cases/formats.ddn.

Projection kinds (12)

Every projection kind the runtime supports, with the profiles bound to each. The optional geo kind requires the ddn-geo.js module; isometric depth is a presentation variant of the graph and chart kinds via the optional ddn-iso.js module (see the iso sheets above).

DDN sources

The browsable sources behind every figure above — one block per unique entry. Multi-file examples (data/format/view split across files) are shown file by file, followed by their combined single-file variant, which the gallery verifies renders byte-identical SVG for every view it renders.

website/examples/basics/01-customer.ddn — multi-file workspace (3 files)

website/examples/basics/01-customer.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.customer-views";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
import "customer-data.ddn" as customer;

view overview "Customer data / a shared model" {
    data: [@customer.model];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    legend: @shared.styles.numbers;
    select: [@customer.model.customer, @customer.model.order, @customer.model.customer_identifier, @customer.model.customers];
    legend { keys: { "model.order_customer": 7, "model.customer_domain": 12, "model.order_domain": 18 }; }

}
view compact "Customer data / compact view" {
    data: [@customer.model];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    display: @shared.styles.compact;
    select: [@customer.model.order, @customer.model.customer];

}
view print "Customer data / print rendition" {
    data: [@customer.model];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    style: @shared.styles.neutral;
    publication: @shared.styles.paper;
    select: [@customer.model.order, @customer.model.customer];

}
view embedded "Customer data / minimal chrome for embedding" {
    data: [@customer.model];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    select: [@customer.model.order, @customer.model.customer];
    // B1-045: the relations already label themselves (legend mode text), so the
    // key is redundant here; title/footer off give a chrome-free embed.
    legend: off;
    title: off;
    footer: off;
}

website/examples/basics/customer-data.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.customer-data";

data model {
    object customer "Customer" {
        uid: "urn:ddn:example:customer";
        kind: table;
        maturity: draft;
        workload: [oltp];
        role: authoritative;
        fields {
            field customer_id { key: primary; domain: @customer_identifier; }
            field display_name;
            field status;
        }
    }
    object order "Order" {
        kind: table;
        maturity: draft;
        workload: [oltp];
        fields {
            field order_id { key: primary; }
            field customer_id { domain: @customer_identifier; }
            field ordered_at;
        }
    }
    domain customer_identifier "Customer identifier" {
        meaning: "Identifies a customer in the registry";
        representation: undecided;
    }
    sample customers "Synthetic customer records" {
        mode: synthetic;
        columns: [@customer.customer_id, @customer.display_name, @customer.status];
        rows: [["C001", "Customer A", "Active"], ["C002", "Customer B", "Suspended"]];
    }
    relation order_customer @order.customer_id -> @customer.customer_id {
        kind: references;
        source_mark: zeromany;
        target_mark: one;
        enforcement: undecided;
    }
    relation customer_domain @customer.customer_id -> @customer_identifier { kind: uses_domain; }
    relation order_domain @order.customer_id -> @customer_identifier { kind: uses_domain; }
}

website/examples/basics/shared.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.shared";

format styles {
    notation core;
    style classic;
    style hand { look: handDrawn; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }
    style neo { look: neo; }
    style dark { theme: dark; }
    style neutral { theme: neutral; font: mono; }
    style forest { look: handDrawn; theme: forest; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }
    layout wires { algorithm: grid; gap: 80px; }
    display detailed;
    display compact { fields: none; maturity: none; badges: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; width: 1360px; height: 860px; margin: 30px; overflow: warn; }
    publication paper { size: a4; orientation: landscape; margin: 8mm; minimum_text: 7pt; overflow: warn; }
    legend words { width: 280px; }
    legend numbers { mode: numbers; width: 280px; }
    bundle technical {
        notation: @core;
        style: @classic;
        layout: @wires;
        display: @detailed;
        publication: @screen;
        legend: @words;
    }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.elements";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

data model {
    object customer "Customer" { kind: table; maturity: draft; workload: [oltp]; fields { field customer_id { key: primary; } field display_name; field status; } }
    object history "Customer history" { kind: history; workload: [olap]; temporal: bitemporal; fields { field customer_id; field valid_from; field recorded_from; } }
    object profile "Profile document" { kind: collection; fields { field customer_id; field address { shape: object; } field tags { shape: array; } } }
    object events "Customer events" { kind: topic; fields { field event_id; field occurred_at; field payload; } }
    object transform "Build history" { kind: activity; }
    object procedure "Reconcile customers" { kind: procedure; fields { field tenant_id; field batch_id; } }
    domain identifier "Customer identifier" { meaning: "Stable registry identity"; representation: undecided; }
    object schema "SQL namespace" { kind: schema; }
    object server "Cloud SQL service" { kind: service; location: cloud; }
    object cloud "Cloud scope" { kind: cloud; }
    object note "Design decision" { kind: note; description: "Examples illustrate intent; the data model remains independent of its look."; }
    sample example "Synthetic rows" { mode: synthetic; columns: [@customer.customer_id, @customer.status]; rows: [["C001", "Active"], ["C002", "Suspended"]]; }
}

website/examples/basics/03-routing.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/03-routing.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.routing";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

data model {
    object west "West source" { kind: dataset; }
    object east "East target" { kind: dataset; }
    object north "North source" { kind: dataset; }
    object south "South target" { kind: dataset; }
    relation horizontal @west -> @east { kind: flow; }
    relation vertical @north -> @south { kind: flow; }
}

view gap "Orthogonal crossing / disconnected gap" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    display: @shared.styles.compact;
    layout { crossings: gap; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "model.horizontal": 4, "model.vertical": 9 }; }
    publication { width: 1300px; height: 850px; }
    place @model.west { at: [0px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.east { at: [630px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.north { at: [315px, 0px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.south { at: [315px, 450px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    route @model.horizontal { source_side: east; target_side: west; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [300px, 270px]; }
    route @model.vertical { source_side: south; target_side: north; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [435px, 365px]; }
}

view bridge "Orthogonal crossing / round bridge" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    display: @shared.styles.compact;
    layout { crossings: bridge; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "model.horizontal": 4, "model.vertical": 9 }; }
    publication { width: 1300px; height: 850px; }
    place @model.west { at: [0px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.east { at: [630px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.north { at: [315px, 0px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.south { at: [315px, 450px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    route @model.horizontal { source_side: east; target_side: west; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [300px, 270px]; }
    route @model.vertical { source_side: south; target_side: north; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [435px, 365px]; }
}

view square_bridge "Orthogonal crossing / square bridge" {

website/examples/basics/04-hybrid.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/04-hybrid.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.hybrid";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

data model {
    object orders "Orders definition" { kind: table; level: definition; distribution: hash; fields { field tenant_id; field order_id; } }
    object shard "Tenant shard A" { kind: shard; level: fragment; }
    object primary "Orders / primary copy" { kind: replica; level: instance; role: primary; location: local; }
    object follower "Orders / follower copy" { kind: replica; level: instance; role: follower; location: cloud; }
    object local "Local database service" { kind: service; location: local; }
    object cloud "Cloud database service" { kind: service; location: cloud; }
    object schema "sales schema" { kind: schema; }
    relation fragment @orders -> @shard { kind: partitioned_into; }
    relation copy1 @primary -> @shard { kind: realizes; }
    relation copy2 @follower -> @shard { kind: realizes; }
    relation on_local @primary -> @local { kind: placed_on; }
    relation on_cloud @follower -> @cloud { kind: placed_on; }
    relation replica_stream @primary -> @follower { kind: replicates_to; delivery: undecided; }
    relation member @orders -> @schema { kind: namespace_member; }
}
view deployment "Hybrid deployment / fragments are not copies" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    display: @shared.styles.compact;
    select: [@model.orders, @model.shard, @model.primary, @model.follower, @model.local, @model.cloud];
    publication { width: 1550px; height: 1050px; }
    legend { mode: numbers; width: 300px; keys: { "fragment": 1, "copy1": 2, "copy2": 3, "on_local": 4, "on_cloud": 5, "replica_stream": 6 }; }

    frame local_scope "ON-PREMISES" { members: [@model.primary, @model.local]; }
    frame cloud_scope "CLOUD" { members: [@model.follower, @model.cloud]; }
}
view namespaces "Namespace / the same data, a different concern" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    select: [@model.orders, @model.schema];

}

website/examples/basics/05-flow.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.flow";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

data model {
    object source "Operational customer" { kind: table; workload: [oltp]; role: authoritative; }
    object capture "Capture changes" { kind: activity; }
    object events "customer.changed" { kind: topic; }
    object history_job "Build valid + recorded history" { kind: activity; }
    object search_job "Build search projection" { kind: activity; }
    object history "Customer history" { kind: history; workload: [olap]; temporal: bitemporal; }
    object search "Customer search" { kind: search_index; role: derived; }
    relation r1 @source -> @capture { kind: captures_changes_into; capture: cdc; }
    relation r2 @capture -> @events { kind: publishes_to; transport: kafka; }
    relation r3 @events -> @history_job { kind: delivers_to; scope: "history consumer"; }
    relation r4 @events -> @search_job { kind: delivers_to; scope: "search consumer"; }
    relation r5 @history_job -> @history { kind: write; }
    relation r6 @search_job -> @search { kind: write; }
}
view flow "Capture, transport and transformation are different" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; display: @shared.styles.compact;
    publication { width: 1550px; height: 1020px; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "r1":1, "r2":2, "r3":3, "r4":4, "r5":5, "r6":6 }; width: 300px; }

}

website/examples/basics/06-temporal.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.temporal";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

data model {
    object history "Customer status history" {
        kind: history; temporal: bitemporal; workload: [olap];
        time: { valid: "business effective date", recorded: "warehouse knowledge date", retention: undecided };
        fields { field customer_id; field status; field valid_from; field recorded_from; }
    }
    sample example "Late-arriving fact / synthetic example" {
        mode: synthetic;
        columns: [@history.customer_id, @history.status, @history.valid_from, @history.recorded_from];
        rows: [["C001", "Active", "2026-03-01", "2026-03-05"], ["C002", "Suspended", "2026-03-02", "2026-03-02"]];
    }
    object recovery "Operational restore plan" { kind: recovery; description: "PITR is a restore capability, not the business-valid time axis."; }
    relation illustration @example -> @history { kind: illustrates; }
}
view temporal "Two time axes / not the same as recovery" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    publication { width: 1480px; height: 800px; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "illustration": 2 }; }

}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.documents";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

data model {
    object profiles "Customer profiles" { kind: collection; fields { field customer_id; field address; field status { presence: optional; nullable: true; } } }
    object address "Embedded address" { kind: document; fields { field street; field city; field postal_code; } }
    object contacts "Contact array" { kind: array; fields { field kind; field value; } }
    sample example "Absent is not null" { mode: synthetic; columns: [@profiles.customer_id, @profiles.status]; rows: [["C001", null], ["C002", missing]]; }
    relation nested @profiles -> @address { kind: embeds; }
    relation repeated @profiles -> @contacts { kind: embeds; }
}
view documents "Document structure / presence versus null" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "nested": 1, "repeated": 2 }; }

}

website/examples/basics/09-look-comparison.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/09-look-comparison.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.lookcomparison";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// One model, three renderings. No at coordinates or manual route waypoints.
data model {
    object customer "Customer" {
        kind: table; maturity: draft; workload: [oltp];
        fields { field customer_id { key: primary; } field status; }
    }
    object builder "Build history" { kind: activity; }
    object history "Customer history" {
        kind: history; workload: [olap]; temporal: bitemporal;
        fields { field customer_id; field valid_from; field recorded_from; }
    }
    relation capture @customer -> @builder { kind: captures_changes_into; capture: cdc; }
    relation load @builder -> @history { kind: write; }
}

view classic "Classic / precise single strokes" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    style: @shared.styles.classic;
    layout { algorithm: grid; columns: 3; gap: 95px; routing: orthogonal; direction: right; }
    publication { width: 1500px; height: 440px; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "capture": 1, "load": 2 }; width: 300px; }
}

view handDrawn "Hand drawn / organic pen strokes" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    style: @shared.styles.hand;
    layout { algorithm: grid; columns: 3; gap: 95px; routing: orthogonal; direction: right; }
    publication { width: 1500px; height: 440px; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "capture": 1, "load": 2 }; width: 300px; }
}

view neo "Neo / raised, precise cards" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    style: @shared.styles.neo;
    layout { algorithm: grid; columns: 3; gap: 95px; routing: orthogonal; direction: right; }
    publication { width: 1500px; height: 440px; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "capture": 1, "load": 2 }; width: 300px; }
}

website/examples/basics/10-handdrawn-routing.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.routinghand";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

data model {
    object west "West source" { kind: dataset; }
    object east "East target" { kind: dataset; }
    object north "North source" { kind: dataset; }
    object south "South target" { kind: dataset; }
    relation horizontal @west -> @east { kind: flow; }
    relation vertical @north -> @south { kind: flow; }
}

view gap "Hand-drawn crossing / disconnected gap" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; style: @shared.styles.hand;
    display: @shared.styles.compact;
    layout { crossings: gap; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "model.horizontal": 4, "model.vertical": 9 }; }
    publication { width: 1300px; height: 850px; }
    place @model.west { at: [0px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.east { at: [630px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.north { at: [315px, 0px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.south { at: [315px, 450px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    route @model.horizontal { source_side: east; target_side: west; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [300px, 270px]; }
    route @model.vertical { source_side: south; target_side: north; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [435px, 365px]; }
}

view bridge "Hand-drawn crossing / round bridge" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; style: @shared.styles.hand;
    display: @shared.styles.compact;
    layout { crossings: bridge; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "model.horizontal": 4, "model.vertical": 9 }; }
    publication { width: 1300px; height: 850px; }
    place @model.west { at: [0px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.east { at: [630px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.north { at: [315px, 0px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.south { at: [315px, 450px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    route @model.horizontal { source_side: east; target_side: west; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [300px, 270px]; }
    route @model.vertical { source_side: south; target_side: north; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [435px, 365px]; }
}

view square_bridge "Hand-drawn crossing / square bridge" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; style: @shared.styles.hand;
    display: @shared.styles.compact;
    layout { crossings: square_bridge; }
    legend { mode: numbers; keys: { "model.horizontal": 4, "model.vertical": 9 }; }
    publication { width: 1300px; height: 850px; }
    place @model.west { at: [0px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.east { at: [630px, 220px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.north { at: [315px, 0px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    place @model.south { at: [315px, 450px]; size: [240px, 100px]; }
    route @model.horizontal { source_side: east; target_side: west; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [300px, 270px]; }
    route @model.vertical { source_side: south; target_side: north; via: [[435px,270px]]; callout: [435px, 365px]; }
}

view straight "Hand-drawn straight routing / relation family unchanged" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; style: @shared.styles.hand;
    select: [@model.west, @model.east];
    layout { routing: straight; }
    place @model.west { at: [0px, 0px]; }
    place @model.east { at: [520px, 240px]; }
}

website/examples/basics/11-native-layouts.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.native-layouts";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
data model {
 object enterprise "Meridian Works" { kind: context; role: authoritative; }
 object finance "Finance" { kind: application; role: authoritative; }
 object plant "Plant operations" { kind: application; role: authoritative; }
 object journal "Posted journals" { kind: table; role: authoritative; fields { field journal_id; field period_id; } }
 object stock "Stock movements" { kind: table; role: authoritative; fields { field movement_id; field lot_id; } }
 object analytics "Warehouse projection" { kind: dataset; role: derived; }
 relation f1 @enterprise -> @finance { kind: assoc; }
 relation f2 @enterprise -> @plant { kind: assoc; }
 relation f3 @finance -> @journal { kind: assoc; }
 relation f4 @plant -> @stock { kind: assoc; }
 relation f5 @plant -> @analytics { kind: assoc; }
}
format options {
 layout grid { algorithm: grid; columns: 3; }
 layout layered { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
 layout tree { algorithm: tree; root: @model.enterprise; hierarchy: [assoc]; }
 layout mindmap { algorithm: mindmap; routing: curved; root: @model.enterprise; hierarchy: [assoc]; }
 layout groups { algorithm: grouped; group_by: role; columns: 2; }
 legend keys { mode: numbers; keys: { f1: 1, f2: 2, f3: 3, f4: 4, f5: 5 }; width: 330px; }
}
view grid "Native grid / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.grid; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view layered "Native layered / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.layered; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view tree "Native tree / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.tree; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view mindmap "Native mind-map / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.mindmap; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view grouped "Native grouped / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.groups; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

module "ddn.examples.native-layouts";
data model {
 object enterprise "Meridian Works" { kind: context; role: authoritative; }
 object finance "Finance" { kind: application; role: authoritative; }
 object plant "Plant operations" { kind: application; role: authoritative; }
 object journal "Posted journals" { kind: table; role: authoritative; fields { field journal_id; field period_id; } }
 object stock "Stock movements" { kind: table; role: authoritative; fields { field movement_id; field lot_id; } }
 object analytics "Warehouse projection" { kind: dataset; role: derived; }
 relation f1 @enterprise -> @finance { kind: assoc; }
 relation f2 @enterprise -> @plant { kind: assoc; }
 relation f3 @finance -> @journal { kind: assoc; }
 relation f4 @plant -> @stock { kind: assoc; }
 relation f5 @plant -> @analytics { kind: assoc; }
}
format options {
 layout grid { algorithm: grid; columns: 3; }
 layout layered { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
 layout tree { algorithm: tree; root: @model.enterprise; hierarchy: [assoc]; }
 layout mindmap { algorithm: mindmap; routing: curved; root: @model.enterprise; hierarchy: [assoc]; }
 layout groups { algorithm: grouped; group_by: role; columns: 2; }
 legend keys { mode: numbers; keys: { f1: 1, f2: 2, f3: 3, f4: 4, f5: 5 }; width: 330px; }
}
view grid "Native grid / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.grid; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view layered "Native layered / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.layered; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view tree "Native tree / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.tree; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view mindmap "Native mind-map / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.mindmap; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}
view grouped "Native grouped / no coordinates" {
 data: [@model]; format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.groups; legend: @options.keys;
 publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

module "ddn.examples.shared";
format styles {
    notation core;
    style classic;
    style hand { look: handDrawn; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }
    style neo { look: neo; }
    style dark { theme: dark; }
    style neutral { theme: neutral; font: mono; }
    style forest { look: handDrawn; theme: forest; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }
    layout wires { algorithm: grid; gap: 80px; }
    display detailed;
    display compact { fields: none; maturity: none; badges: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; width: 1360px; height: 860px; margin: 30px; overflow: warn; }
    publication paper { size: a4; orientation: landscape; margin: 8mm; minimum_text: 7pt; overflow: warn; }
    legend words { width: 280px; }
    legend numbers { mode: numbers; width: 280px; }
    bundle technical {
        notation: @core;
        style: @classic;
        layout: @wires;
        display: @detailed;
        publication: @screen;
        legend: @words;
    }
}
website/examples/basics/12-nested-fields.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/12-nested-fields.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.nested";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
// Teaching example for compact authoring (phases 1–3): kind keywords act as
// declaration keywords, field/port keywords may be omitted inside
// fields {}/ports {} blocks, relationship keywords act as relation verbs with
// optional [mark] brackets, `relations <kind> { … }` batches expand to one
// relation per entry, and one-line view headers expand to canonical
// data + projection. All forms desugar to the identical canonical
// declarations — the verbose equivalents are shown in comments.
data model {
 domain identifier "Customer identifier" { meaning: "Opaque identifier within the customer registry"; }
 domain postal "Postal code" {meaning:"Postal routing code, with country context required";}
 // verbose: object customer "Customer profile / nested structure" { kind: collection; … }
 collection customer "Customer profile / nested structure" {
  fields {
   // verbose: field customer_id {…} — explicit field/port stays valid and mixes freely
   customer_id {domain: @identifier; datatype: "string"; key: true; nullable: false;}
   address {shape: object; presence: optional; nullable: false;
    fields { street; city; postal_code {datatype: "string";} }
   }
   contacts {shape: array; presence: optional;
    fields {kind {datatype: "string";} value {datatype: "string";nullable: true;} }
   }
   delivery {shape: variant; discriminator: "method"; variants: [pickup, courier];
    fields {method; location {presence: optional;} }
   }
  }
 }
 // verbose: object order "Order" { kind: table; fields { field order_id; field customer_id {…} } }
 table order "Order" {fields {order_id; customer_id {domain: @identifier;}}}
 // verbose: relation owner @order.customer_id -> @customer.customer_id {kind: ref; source_mark: one; target_mark: one; enforcement: undecided;}
 ref owner @order.customer_id [one] -> @customer.customer_id [one] {enforcement: undecided;}
 // verbose: relation address_note @customer.address.postal_code -> @postal {kind: candidate;}
 //          relation id_match @order.customer_id -> @identifier {kind: candidate;}
 relations candidate {
  address_note @customer.address.postal_code -> @postal;
  id_match @order.customer_id -> @identifier;
 }
}
view detailed "Nested fields / domains and representations" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; select: [@model.order,@model.customer,@model.postal];
 layout {algorithm: layered;}
 display {domains: show; datatypes: show; depth: 8;}
 legend {mode: numbers; keys: {owner: 7,address_note: 12};}
 publication {size: content;fit: none;overflow: error;}
}
view large "20px base / measured wrapping" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; select: [@model.customer];
 style {font_size: 20px;}
 display {domains: show;datatypes: show;}
 publication {size: content;fit: none;overflow: error;}
}
view collapsed "Hidden nested rows / preserved endpoint identities" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; select: [@model.order,@model.customer,@model.postal];
 display {depth: 0;fields: names;}
 layout {algorithm: layered;}
 publication {size: content;fit: none;overflow: error;}
}
// verbose: view header "One-line header / compact view declaration" {
//   data: [@model]; projection { kind: graph; profile: "ddn@1"; }
//   select: [@model.order,@model.customer]; … }
view header "One-line header / compact view declaration": @model as "ddn@1" {
 format: @shared.styles.technical; select: [@model.order,@model.customer];
 publication {size: content;fit: none;overflow: error;}
}
// verbose:
//   data metrics {
//    object m1 "Alpha" { kind: record; x_record: { label: "Alpha", value: 10, unit: "ms" }; }
//    object m2 "Beta" { kind: record; x_record: { label: "Beta", value: 20, unit: "ms" }; }
//    object m3 "Gamma" { kind: record; x_record: { label: "Gamma", value: 15, unit: "ms" }; }
//    object m4 "Delta" { kind: record; x_record: { label: "Delta", value: 25, unit: "ms" }; }
//    object m5 "m5" { kind: record; x_record: { label: missing, value: null, unit: "ms" }; note: "awaiting measurement"; }
//   }
records metrics {
 columns: label, value, unit;
 label_column: label;
 row m1: "Alpha", 10, "ms";
 row m2: "Beta", 20, "ms";
 row m3: "Gamma", 15, "ms";
 row m4: "Delta", 25, "ms";
 row m5: missing, null, "ms" { note: "awaiting measurement"; };
}
view metrics_chart "Order timings / keyed tabular records" {
 data: [@metrics];
 projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@metrics.m1, @metrics.m2, @metrics.m3, @metrics.m4]; mark: bar; x: "x_record.label"; y: "x_record.value"; unit: "ms"; width: 900px; height: 560px; }
 publication {size: content;fit: none;}
}

module "ddn.examples.publication";

data model {
 object source "Order input" {kind: record; fields {field order_id;field amount;}}
 object validated "Accepted order" {kind: record;fields {field order_id;field amount;}}
 relation check "Validated input" @source -> @validated {kind: flow;}
}
view paper "A4 / explicit minimum text" {

 layout {algorithm: layered;}
 display {fields: none;}
 legend {mode: numbers;keys: {check: 1};placement: bottom;}
 publication {size: a4;orientation: landscape;fit: reflow;margin: 8mm;minimum_text: 7pt;overflow: error;}
}
view screen "Content-sized / same semantic model" {
 data:[@model];format:@shared.styles.technical;
 layout {algorithm: layered;}
 publication {size: content;fit: none;overflow: error;}
}

website/examples/basics/14-authorized-export.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.export";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
data model {
 object workforce "Workforce public directory" {
  kind: table;
  fields {field staff_id; field display_name; field salary {classification: restricted;}}
  description: "Synthetic restricted note: SALARY_SECRET_CANARY";
 }
 object team "Team" {kind: table;fields {field team_id;field name;}}
 relation membership "Membership" @workforce -> @team {kind: ref;}
}
view private "Private source / hiding is not redaction" {
 data: [@model];format: @shared.styles.technical;
 display {fields: none;}
 publication {size: content;fit: none;overflow: error;}
}
view public "Allowlisted publication" {
 data: [@model];format: @shared.styles.technical;
 export {
  mode: redacted;
  elements: [@model.workforce, @model.team];
  fields: [@model.workforce.staff_id,@model.workforce.display_name,@model.team.team_id,@model.team.name];
  properties: [kind];
  identifier_mode: opaque;
  title: "Public directory / approved projection";
 }
 publication {size: content;fit: none;overflow: error;}
}

website/examples/basics/15-process-contracts.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.process";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
data model {
 object request "Stock-transfer command" {kind: message;fields {field command_id;field source_id;field target_id;}}
 object result "Transfer decision" {kind: message;fields {field command_id;field state;}}
 object transfer "Transfer boundary" {kind: pipeline;
  ports {port input {direction: in;payload: @request;} port output {direction: out;payload: @result;}}
  x_boundary: {ports:[@transfer.input,@transfer.output],bindings:[{external:@transfer.input,internal:@validate.input},{external:@transfer.output,internal:@validate.output}]};
 }
 object validate "Validate and reserve" {kind: activity;
  ports {port input {direction: in;payload: @request;} port output {direction: out;payload: @result;}}
  x_workflow: {
   states:[pending,accepted,rejected,compensated],initial:pending,terminal:[rejected,compensated],
   transitions:[
    {id:approve,from:pending,to:accepted,event:decide,guard:{field:"approved",op:eq,value:true}},
    {id:deny,from:pending,to:rejected,event:decide,guard:{field:"approved",op:eq,value:false}},
    {id:cancel,from:accepted,to:compensated,event:cancel,guard:true}
   ]
  };
  x_reconciliation: {owner:"Inventory command service",idempotency_key:"command_id",states:[pending,accepted,rejected,compensated],timeout:"PT5M",compensation:"release allocation once",evidence:"durable decision and recovery checkpoint"};
 }
 object deployment_gate "Operational verification pending" {kind: rule;
  x_requirement: {id:"R-OPS",owner:"SRE reviewer",acceptance:"Run outage, duplicate delivery and replay tests against real infrastructure",state:required};
 }
 relation input @request -> @transfer.input {kind: flow;}
 relation internal @transfer -> @validate {kind: depends;}
 relation output @transfer.output -> @result {kind: flow;}
 relation gate @validate -> @deployment_gate {kind: depends;}
}
view balanced "Balanced interfaces / declared state and verification" {
 data: [@model];format:@shared.styles.technical;
 layout {algorithm: layered;}
 legend {mode:numbers;keys:{input:1,internal:2,output:3,gate:4};}
 publication {size:content;fit:none;overflow:error;}
}

website/examples/basics/15-process-contracts.combined.ddn (combined single-file variant — renders identically)

ddn "0.5";

module "ddn.examples.process";
data model {
 object request "Stock-transfer command" {kind: message;fields {field command_id;field source_id;field target_id;}}
 object result "Transfer decision" {kind: message;fields {field command_id;field state;}}
 object transfer "Transfer boundary" {kind: pipeline;
  ports {port input {direction: in;payload: @request;} port output {direction: out;payload: @result;}}
  x_boundary: {ports:[@transfer.input,@transfer.output],bindings:[{external:@transfer.input,internal:@validate.input},{external:@transfer.output,internal:@validate.output}]};
 }
 object validate "Validate and reserve" {kind: activity;
  ports {port input {direction: in;payload: @request;} port output {direction: out;payload: @result;}}
  x_workflow: {
   states:[pending,accepted,rejected,compensated],initial:pending,terminal:[rejected,compensated],
   transitions:[
    {id:approve,from:pending,to:accepted,event:decide,guard:{field:"approved",op:eq,value:true}},
    {id:deny,from:pending,to:rejected,event:decide,guard:{field:"approved",op:eq,value:false}},
    {id:cancel,from:accepted,to:compensated,event:cancel,guard:true}
   ]
  };
  x_reconciliation: {owner:"Inventory command service",idempotency_key:"command_id",states:[pending,accepted,rejected,compensated],timeout:"PT5M",compensation:"release allocation once",evidence:"durable decision and recovery checkpoint"};
 }
 object deployment_gate "Operational verification pending" {kind: rule;
  x_requirement: {id:"R-OPS",owner:"SRE reviewer",acceptance:"Run outage, duplicate delivery and replay tests against real infrastructure",state:required};
 }
 relation input @request -> @transfer.input {kind: flow;}
 relation internal @transfer -> @validate {kind: depends;}
 relation output @transfer.output -> @result {kind: flow;}
 relation gate @validate -> @deployment_gate {kind: depends;}
}
view balanced "Balanced interfaces / declared state and verification" {
 data: [@model];format:@ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical;
 layout {algorithm: layered;}
 legend {mode:numbers;keys:{input:1,internal:2,output:3,gate:4};}
 publication {size:content;fit:none;overflow:error;}
}

module "ddn.examples.shared";
format styles {

    style neo { look: neo; }
    style dark { theme: dark; }
    style neutral { theme: neutral; font: mono; }
    style forest { look: handDrawn; theme: forest; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }
    layout wires { algorithm: grid; gap: 80px; }
    display detailed;
    display compact { fields: none; maturity: none; badges: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; width: 1360px; height: 860px; margin: 30px; overflow: warn; }
    publication paper { size: a4; orientation: landscape; margin: 8mm; minimum_text: 7pt; overflow: warn; }
    legend words { width: 280px; }
    legend numbers { mode: numbers; width: 280px; }
    bundle technical {
        notation: @core;

    }
}

website/examples/basics/16-enterprise-gates.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.enterprise.readiness";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
data gates {
 object issue001 "Automatic grid routes through an unrelated object" {kind:rule;
  description: "Native obstacle-aware router; A\u2192C avoids intervening B. Pins and infeasible clearances fail explicitly.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-001", "owner": "DDN layout maintainer", "acceptance": "Native core routes the three-node counterexample without any unrelated box intersection; test adversarial ports and dense fields.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue002 "Shared connector tracks and callout interference remain" {kind:rule;
  description: "Independent endpoint lanes, reserved ports and callout corridors; independent full-corpus scanner is now an error gate.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-002", "owner": "DDN renderer maintainer / technical writer", "acceptance": "Distinguish shared port stubs from unrelated shared trunks, then require unique visible signatures and zero unrelated-callout masking across the corpus.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue003 "Relationship endpoint compatibility is not enforced" {kind:rule;
  description: "Every relation has executable endpoint-kind/member/self constraints. Invalid known kind pairs fail before drawing.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-003", "owner": "Language/compiler maintainer", "acceptance": "Reject invalid endpoint-kind pairs and preserve valid vendor-extension fallbacks without silently guessing.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue004 "Extension business metadata is preserved but not validated" {kind:rule;
  description: "Registered typed x_erp and other extension validators reject malformed data. Unknown extensions are warned or rejected by strict mode.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-004", "owner": "Language/ERP schema reviewers", "acceptance": "Reject malformed typed metadata, unknown semantics and invalid compound references, with field-level diagnostics.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue005 "Requested domain display is ignored" {kind:rule;
  description: "Domain/datatype display resolves names without changing model identities.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-005", "owner": "DDN renderer maintainer", "acceptance": "A visible domain badge/text resolves to the correct stable domain; toggling it preserves model hash.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue006 "fit:none with overflow:error can silently clip content" {kind:rule;
  description: "Every implemented fit mode checks bounds and final text size; embedding/inline sizes are checked. Unsupported pagination is rejected.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-006", "owner": "Publication maintainer", "acceptance": "Reject or reflow every out-of-bounds element/label under overflow:error; no hidden clipping in print.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue007 "Scalable fonts and accurate text measurement remain unsupported" {kind:rule;
  description: "Variable base sizes and browser/pinned measurements are implemented; unknown runs have explicit warnings or fail under metrics:required. Cross-machine font/bidi qualification remains external.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-007", "owner": "Typography/accessibility reviewer", "acceptance": "Measure resolved fonts and actual text runs; verify final embedding scale, Unicode shaping and no overflow in Chrome and Firefox.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue008 "Hidden detail remains in a full semantic export" {kind:rule;
  description: "Shared allowlist export projector is used by SVG, JSON, CLI and editor. Hidden private source is not mistaken for public output.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-008", "owner": "Security/privacy reviewer", "acceptance": "Authorized export closure excludes protected fields, examples and metadata from SVG/JSON/source/tooltips, with negative tests.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue009 "Nested field syntax is not yet executable" {kind:rule;
  description: "Recursive fields have stable path/parent/depth identities and member endpoints. Variant/presence/null declarations remain explicit.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-009", "owner": "Language maintainer", "acceptance": "Validate/render nested arrays, variants and optional/null states with stable field-level endpoints.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue010 "Layered layout appears in the specification but is rejected" {kind:rule;
  description: "Native grid/manual/layered/tree/mindmap/grouped algorithms; executable capability manifest prevents unsupported enum drift.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-010", "owner": "Specification editor", "acceptance": "Every documented enum value has an implemented conformance level or explicit unsupported status.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue011 "Derived datasets were initially labeled authoritative" {kind:rule;
  description: "Corrected role/workload mapping; regression checks now cover projections and analytic facts.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-MOD-011", "owner": "Data architect", "acceptance": "Re-run case-checks; inspect analytical run/evidence roles separately from business facts.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue012 "Finished-goods sample drifted from loaded labor costing" {kind:rule;
  description: "Corrected source/generator and explicit expected stock value630 check.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-MOD-012", "owner": "Cost accountant", "acceptance": "Changing labor input must update fixture and samples or fail validation.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue013 "Minute fields shared an elapsed-seconds domain" {kind:rule;
  description: "Added explicit elapsed-minute domain; named minute fields now bind it.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-MOD-013", "owner": "Manufacturing/data architect", "acceptance": "Verify every duration interface declares conversion; case-check minutes-domain test remains green.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue014 "Same-company keys do not cover all cross-entity affinity rules" {kind:rule;
  description: "DDN x_affinity records explicit comparisons and enforcement responsibility; fixture checks are available. Target-engine race/affinity enforcement is still unverified.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-MOD-014", "owner": "DBA / controller", "acceptance": "Negative tests for cross-company cost centre, wrong period/book, wrong warehouse owner and intentional intercompany exception.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue015 "Cross-database references require durable reconciliation" {kind:rule;
  description: "DDN x_reconciliation requires idempotency, state outcomes, timeout, compensation and evidence. Real cross-service recovery remains unverified.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-MOD-015", "owner": "Distributed-systems / workforce architect", "acceptance": "Inject outage, stale reference, revoked employment and duplicate acceptance; ensure no unmatched labor/payroll/ledger effect.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue016 "Jurisdictional accounting/payroll/privacy policies not approved" {kind:rule;
  description: "Explicit required gate: approved jurisdiction policies and genuine expert evidence are absent; no diagram can manufacture them.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-POL-016", "owner": "Controller / payroll specialist / privacy counsel", "acceptance": "Approve versioned jurisdiction matrix and independent calculation/evidence suites; document exclusions explicitly.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue017 "Full temporal/uniqueness/mutation enforcement is not implemented" {kind:rule;
  description: "DDN x_constraint declares uniqueness, half-open interval and immutable-state contracts with fixture checks. Production database migrations remain review-only.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-MOD-017", "owner": "DBA / data architect", "acceptance": "Execute migrations against selected engine; mutation/property tests for interval overlap, history correction and posted-line immutability.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue018 "No distributed load, broker, bank or restore drill has run" {kind:rule;
  description: "Required operational evidence remains absent. No live broker, bank, load or restore drill is claimed.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-OPS-018", "owner": "SRE / integration owner", "acceptance": "Measured failover fencing, recovery consistency, broker restart, bank-unknown-outcome reconciliation and peak contention tests.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue019 "UI/report requirements are not finished executable applications" {kind:rule;
  description: "Typed x_ui/x_report can validate field/command/grain/cutoff contracts. The ERP screens and reports remain specifications/wireframes, not finished applications.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-APP-019", "owner": "UX / report owner / application architect", "acceptance": "Authorize and test commands end-to-end; reconcile each production report at fixed source cuts; keyboard/assistive testing.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue020 "DFD steps are not an executable workflow or formal balanced DFD certification" {kind:rule;
  description: "Balanced port/payload contracts and bounded branch/guard/retry fixtures added. Not an orchestration runtime or formal DFD certification.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-020", "owner": "Process analyst / DDN standards reviewer", "acceptance": "Guard/branch/loop and boundary-balance fixtures including missing, duplicated and incompatible ports.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue021 "Mind-map and obstacle avoidance use a case-specific hint generator" {kind:rule;
  description: "Native mindmap/tree/layered placement replaces the case-only helper. Current enterprise sources contain no generated placement/waypoint blocks.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-021", "owner": "DDN layout maintainer", "acceptance": "Native reusable layout presets, deterministic stability and explicit failure diagnostics across unrelated inputs.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue022 "Hash-chain fixture is not tamper-proof evidence custody" {kind:rule;
  description: "x_custody makes independent anchor/key/retention/hold/evidence responsibilities explicit; real custody and privileged-administrator testing remain required.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-SEC-022", "owner": "Auditor / security engineer", "acceptance": "Adversarial administrator exercise plus independently verified retention/hold/export custody evidence.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue023 "Specialized financial/manufacturing algorithms remain bounded" {kind:rule;
  description: "Specialized algorithms remain subject to scoped fixtures and policy approval; labels are not implementation evidence.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-FIN-023", "owner": "Controller / manufacturing specialist", "acceptance": "Approved policies and adversarial numeric examples for every in-scope specialized operation.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue024 "No independent professional signoff yet" {kind:rule;
  description: "Independent reviewer slots remain blank. Author tests do not sign on behalf of accountants, SREs, auditors or privacy counsel.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-REV-024", "owner": "Review chair", "acceptance": "Each mandatory role signs exact model/spec/code hash and records accepted residual risk; unresolved critical items block production.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue025 "Whole-model A4 output correctly rejected" {kind:rule;
  description: "Readability guard retained. Bounded linked views replace illegible whole-model paper output.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-DDN-025", "owner": "Technical writer", "acceptance": "Retain rejection fixture and verify additional page/fit modes under ERP-DDN-006.", "state": "required"};
 }
 object issue026 "Findings filter option was malformed during initial build" {kind:rule;
  description: "Corrected the HTML source and added explicit count/filter browser regression checks. Normal HTTP navigation is independently blocked by the test environment and is not counted as application success.";
  x_requirement: {"id": "ERP-WEB-026", "owner": "Web editor maintainer", "acceptance": "All 26 findings selectable; nine external gates, 11 reference-verified fixes and one scoped typography item remain separately filterable in the 0.3 review site.", "state": "required"};
 }
}
view external "External gates / required evidence" {data:[@gates];format:@shared.styles.technical;
select:[@gates.issue014,@gates.issue015,@gates.issue016,@gates.issue017,@gates.issue018,@gates.issue019,@gates.issue022,@gates.issue023,@gates.issue024];
layout {algorithm:grid;columns:3;} publication {size:content;fit:none;overflow:error;} }
view software "Software changes / independent review checklist" {data:[@gates];format:@shared.styles.technical;
select:[@gates.issue001,@gates.issue002,@gates.issue003,@gates.issue004,@gates.issue005,@gates.issue006,@gates.issue007,@gates.issue008,@gates.issue009,@gates.issue010,@gates.issue020,@gates.issue021];
layout {algorithm:grid;columns:3;} publication {size:content;fit:none;overflow:error;} }

website/examples/basics/17-curved-relations.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.curved-relations";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// One semantic graph, several independent routing and drawing choices.
data capabilities {
 object enterprise "Meridian Works" { kind: context; }
 object finance "Accounting" { kind: application; }
 object inventory "Inventory control" { kind: application; }
 object production "Production control" { kind: application; }
 object logistics "Logistics" { kind: application; }
 object workforce "Human resources" { kind: application; }
 object journals "Journals and periods" { kind: dataset; }
 object lots "Lots and reservations" { kind: dataset; }
 object work_orders "Work orders and WIP" { kind: dataset; }
 object shipments "Loads and delivery" { kind: dataset; }
 object employment "Employment and payroll" { kind: dataset; }
 relation f01 @enterprise -> @finance { kind: assoc; }
 relation f02 @enterprise -> @inventory { kind: assoc; }
 relation f03 @enterprise -> @production { kind: assoc; }
 relation f04 @enterprise -> @logistics { kind: assoc; }
 relation f05 @enterprise -> @workforce { kind: assoc; }
 relation f06 @finance -> @journals { kind: assoc; }
 relation f07 @inventory -> @lots { kind: assoc; }
 relation f08 @production -> @work_orders { kind: assoc; }
 relation f09 @logistics -> @shipments { kind: assoc; }
 relation f10 @workforce -> @employment { kind: assoc; }
}
data exchange {
 object client "Client" { kind: application; }
 object manager "Connection manager" { kind: application; }
 relation request "Connection request" @client -> @manager { kind: flow; }
 relation response "Authentication prompt" @manager -> @client { kind: flow; }
 relation verify "Validate negotiated settings" @manager -> @manager { kind: invoke; }
}
data crossing {
 object a "Orders source" { kind: dataset; }
 object b "Stock source" { kind: dataset; }
 object c "Stock projection" { kind: dataset; }
 object d "Orders projection" { kind: dataset; }
 relation orders "Order projection input" @a -> @d { kind: flow; }
 relation stock "Stock projection input" @b -> @c { kind: derives; }
}
data obstruction {
 object source "Upstream" { kind: dataset; }
 object unrelated "Unrelated database" { kind: database; }
 object target "Downstream" { kind: dataset; }
 relation deliver "Route around unrelated storage" @source -> @target { kind: flow; }
}
format options {
 layout branch_layout { algorithm: mindmap; root: @capabilities.enterprise; hierarchy: [assoc]; routing: curved; curve: bezier; curve_tension: 0.5; crossings: gap; gap: 150px; }
 legend branches { mode: numbers; keys: { f01:1,f02:2,f03:3,f04:4,f05:5,f06:6,f07:7,f08:8,f09:9,f10:10 }; width: 350px; }
 legend exchange { mode: numbers; keys: { request:1,response:2,verify:3 }; width: 350px; }
 legend crossing { mode: numbers; keys: { orders:1,stock:2 }; width: 350px; }
 publication screen { size: content; fit: none; }
}
view mindmap_classic "Curved mind-map / classic" {
 data: [@capabilities]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 layout: @options.branch_layout; legend: @options.branches; publication: @options.screen;
 display { fields: none; }
}
view mindmap_handdrawn "Curved mind-map / handDrawn" {
 data: [@capabilities]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 layout: @options.branch_layout; legend: @options.branches; publication: @options.screen;
 style { look: handDrawn; font: sans; seed: 42; }
 display { fields: none; }
}
view mindmap_neo "Curved mind-map / neo" {
 data: [@capabilities]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 layout: @options.branch_layout; legend: @options.branches; publication: @options.screen;
 style { look: neo; }
 display { fields: none; }
}
view mindmap_angular "Same mind-map / orthogonal routes" {
 data: [@capabilities]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 layout: @options.branch_layout; legend: @options.branches; publication: @options.screen;
 layout { routing: orthogonal; }
 display { fields: none; }
}
view mindmap_rounded "Same mind-map / rounded corridor corners" {
 data: [@capabilities]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 layout: @options.branch_layout; legend: @options.branches; publication: @options.screen;
 layout { curve: rounded; curve_radius: 36px; }
 display { fields: none; }
}
view mixed "One view / independent per-relation route overrides" {
 data: [@capabilities]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 layout: @options.branch_layout; legend: @options.branches; publication: @options.screen;
 display { fields: none; }
 route @capabilities.f01 { routing: orthogonal; }
 route @capabilities.f06 { routing: straight; }
 route @capabilities.f03 { routing: curved; curve: rounded; curve_radius: 24px; }
}
view crossing_gap "Curved disconnected crossing / gap" {
 data: [@crossing]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 legend: @options.crossing; publication: @options.screen;
 layout { algorithm: manual; routing: curved; curve: bezier; crossings: gap; }
 place @crossing.a { at: [0px,0px]; }
 place @crossing.b { at: [0px,480px]; }
 place @crossing.c { at: [800px,0px]; }
 place @crossing.d { at: [800px,480px]; }
}
view crossing_bridge "Curved disconnected crossing / rounded jump" {
 data: [@crossing]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 legend: @options.crossing; publication: @options.screen;
 layout { algorithm: manual; routing: curved; curve: bezier; crossings: bridge; }
 place @crossing.a { at: [0px,0px]; }
 place @crossing.b { at: [0px,480px]; }
 place @crossing.c { at: [800px,0px]; }
 place @crossing.d { at: [800px,480px]; }
}
view crossing_square "Curved disconnected crossing / local square jump" {
 data: [@crossing]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 legend: @options.crossing; publication: @options.screen;
 layout { algorithm: manual; routing: curved; curve: bezier; crossings: square_bridge; }
 place @crossing.a { at: [0px,0px]; }
 place @crossing.b { at: [0px,480px]; }
 place @crossing.c { at: [800px,0px]; }
 place @crossing.d { at: [800px,480px]; }
}
view obstacle "Curved detour / no relation to the middle database" {
 data: [@obstruction]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 publication: @options.screen;
 layout { algorithm: grid; columns: 3; routing: curved; curve: bezier; }
 legend { mode: numbers; keys: { deliver: 1 }; }
}
view bidirectional "Curved request, response and internal action" {
 data: [@exchange]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
 publication: @options.screen; legend: @options.exchange;
 layout { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; curve: bezier; gap: 180px; }
}

website/examples/basics/18-routing-comparison.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.routing-comparison";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
data model {
 object scope "Shared definition" { kind: context; }
 object logical "Logical view" { kind: dataset; }
 object physical "Deployment view" { kind: dataset; }
 relation a "Same model, first view" @scope -> @logical { kind: assoc; }
 relation b "Same model, second view" @scope -> @physical { kind: assoc; }
}
format policies {
 layout branch { algorithm: tree; root: @model.scope; hierarchy: [assoc]; gap: 250px; row_gap: 120px; }
 publication screen { size: content; fit: none; }
 legend keys { mode: numbers; keys: { a: 1, b: 2 }; width: 300px; }
}
view orthogonal "Orthogonal / sharp corners" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @policies.branch; publication: @policies.screen; legend: @policies.keys;
 layout { routing: orthogonal; }
}
view straight "Straight / direct segments" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @policies.branch; publication: @policies.screen; legend: @policies.keys;
 layout { routing: straight; }
}
view bezier "Curved / broad cubic branches" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @policies.branch; publication: @policies.screen; legend: @policies.keys;
 layout { routing: curved; curve: bezier; curve_tension: 0.5; }
}
view rounded "Curved / softened route corners" {
 data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @policies.branch; publication: @policies.screen; legend: @policies.keys;
 layout { routing: curved; curve: rounded; curve_radius: 36px; }
}

website/examples/basics/19-radar-chart.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.radar";

// Synthetic product-evaluation dataset: 6 criteria x 2 products.
data facts {
    object a1 "Aurora / Battery" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Aurora", "criterion": "Battery", "score": 8, "unit": "points"}; }
    object a2 "Aurora / Camera" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Aurora", "criterion": "Camera", "score": 6, "unit": "points"}; }
    object a3 "Aurora / Display" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Aurora", "criterion": "Display", "score": 9, "unit": "points"}; }
    object a4 "Aurora / Performance" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Aurora", "criterion": "Performance", "score": 7, "unit": "points"}; }
    object a5 "Aurora / Durability" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Aurora", "criterion": "Durability", "score": 5, "unit": "points"}; }
    object a6 "Aurora / Value" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Aurora", "criterion": "Value", "score": 6, "unit": "points"}; }
    object n1 "Nimbus / Battery" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Nimbus", "criterion": "Battery", "score": 6, "unit": "points"}; }
    object n2 "Nimbus / Camera" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Nimbus", "criterion": "Camera", "score": 9, "unit": "points"}; }
    object n3 "Nimbus / Display" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Nimbus", "criterion": "Display", "score": 7, "unit": "points"}; }
    object n4 "Nimbus / Performance" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Nimbus", "criterion": "Performance", "score": 8, "unit": "points"}; }
    object n5 "Nimbus / Durability" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Nimbus", "criterion": "Durability", "score": 8, "unit": "points"}; }
    object n6 "Nimbus / Value" { kind: record; x_record: {"product": "Nimbus", "criterion": "Value", "score": 4, "unit": "points"}; }
}

format shared {
    style standard;
    layout logical { algorithm: layered; gap: 140px; row_gap: 130px; }
    display readable { kind: none; badges: none; maturity: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; fit: none; }
    legend key { placement: none; }
    bundle common { style: @standard; layout: @logical; display: @readable; publication: @screen; legend: @key; }
}

view radar "Product comparison / radar" {
    data: [@facts];
    format: @shared.common;
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.radar@1"; records: [@facts.a1, @facts.a2, @facts.a3, @facts.a4, @facts.a5, @facts.a6, @facts.n1, @facts.n2, @facts.n3, @facts.n4, @facts.n5, @facts.n6]; mark: radar; x: "x_record.criterion"; y: "x_record.score"; series: "x_record.product"; unit: "points"; width: 1050px; height: 700px; }
}

website/examples/basics/shared.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.shared";

format styles {
    notation core;
    style classic;
    style hand { look: handDrawn; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }

    style dark { theme: dark; }

    bundle technical {
        notation: @core;
        style: @classic;
        layout: @wires;
        display: @detailed;
        publication: @screen;
        legend: @words;
    }
}

    object f1 "grid → heating" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "grid", "target": "heating", "value": 40, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f2 "grid → it" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "grid", "target": "it", "value": 30, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f3 "gas → heating" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "gas", "target": "heating", "value": 35, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f4 "solar → it" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "solar", "target": "it", "value": 15, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f5 "heating → building_a" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "heating", "target": "building_a", "value": 45, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f6 "heating → building_b" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "heating", "target": "building_b", "value": 30, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f7 "it → building_a" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "it", "target": "building_a", "value": 45, "unit": "MWh"}; }
}

ddn "0.5";

module "ddn.examples.sankey";
// Synthetic energy-spend dataset: seven flows across three stages.
// All data is synthetic.
data energy {
    object f1 "grid → heating" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "grid", "target": "heating", "value": 40, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f2 "grid → it" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "grid", "target": "it", "value": 30, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f3 "gas → heating" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "gas", "target": "heating", "value": 35, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f4 "solar → it" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "solar", "target": "it", "value": 15, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f5 "heating → building_a" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "heating", "target": "building_a", "value": 45, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f6 "heating → building_b" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "heating", "target": "building_b", "value": 30, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f7 "it → building_a" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "it", "target": "building_a", "value": 45, "unit": "MWh"}; }
}

view sankey "Synthetic energy spend across three stages / sankey" {
    data: [@energy]; format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:chart; profile:"chart.sankey@1"; records:[@energy.f1, @energy.f2, @energy.f3, @energy.f4, @energy.f5, @energy.f6, @energy.f7]; mark:sankey; x:"x_record.source"; target:"x_record.target"; y:"x_record.value"; unit:"MWh"; width:1120px; height:620px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/25-c4-views.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.c4-views";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic online-shop workspace for the C4-style profiles. All data is synthetic.
data shop {
    object customer "Customer" { kind: "c4.person"; }
    object site "Online shop" { kind: "c4.system"; }
    object mailer "Notification service" { kind: "c4.system"; }
    object web "Web application" { kind: "c4.container"; }
    object db "Orders database" { kind: "c4.store"; }
    object events "Order events" { kind: "c4.queue"; }
    object checkout "Checkout component" { kind: "c4.component"; }
    object cart "Cart component" { kind: "c4.component"; }
    relation browses "Browses and buys" @customer -> @site { kind: "c4.rel"; }
    relation notifies "Sends notifications" @site -> @mailer { kind: "c4.rel"; }
    relation visits @customer -> @web { kind: "c4.rel"; }
    relation orders "Reads/writes orders" @web -> @db { kind: "c4.rel"; }
    relation publishes "Publishes order events" @web -> @events { kind: "c4.rel"; }
    relation persists @checkout -> @db { kind: "c4.rel"; }
    relation uses "Uses" @cart -> @checkout { kind: "c4.rel"; }
}

format options {
    layout c4ctx { algorithm: layered; }
    layout c4grid { algorithm: grid; }
    layout c4layered { algorithm: layered; }
}

view context "Synthetic shop / C4 context" {
    data: [@shop]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "c4.context@1"; }
    select: [@shop.customer, @shop.site, @shop.mailer];
    display { fields: none; }
    layout: @options.c4ctx;
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view container "Synthetic shop / C4 container" {
    data: [@shop]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "c4.container@1"; }
    select: [@shop.customer, @shop.site, @shop.web, @shop.db, @shop.events];
    display { fields: none; }
    layout: @options.c4grid;
    frame system_boundary { scope: @shop.site; members: [@shop.web, @shop.db, @shop.events]; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view component "Synthetic shop / C4 component" {
    data: [@shop]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "c4.component@1"; }
    select: [@shop.customer, @shop.web, @shop.checkout, @shop.cart, @shop.db];
    display { fields: none; }
    layout: @options.c4layered;
    frame container_boundary { scope: @shop.web; members: [@shop.checkout, @shop.cart]; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.org-chart";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic 8-person organisation for the org.tree@1 profile. All people are fictional.
data people {
    object ceo "A. Rivera — CEO" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object vp_eng "B. Okafor — VP Engineering" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object vp_fin "C. Novak — VP Finance" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object vp_ops "D. Sato — VP Operations" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object lead_plat "E. Mbeki — Platform lead" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object lead_qa "F. Costa — QA lead" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object lead_ar "G. Lund — AR lead" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object lead_fleet "H. Petit — Fleet lead" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    relation r1 @ceo -> @vp_eng { kind: reports_to; }
    relation r2 @ceo -> @vp_fin { kind: reports_to; }
    relation r3 @ceo -> @vp_ops { kind: reports_to; }
    relation r4 @vp_eng -> @lead_plat { kind: reports_to; }
    relation r5 @vp_eng -> @lead_qa { kind: reports_to; }
    relation r6 @vp_fin -> @lead_ar { kind: reports_to; }
    relation r7 @vp_ops -> @lead_fleet { kind: reports_to; }
}

format options {
    layout org { algorithm: tree; direction: down; root: @people.ceo; hierarchy: [reports_to]; }
}

view org "Synthetic organisation / org chart" {
    data: [@people]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.org;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "org.tree@1"; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

    object discount "Annual discount" { kind: term; }
    object tour "Sample data tour" { kind: term; }

    relation r3 @root -> @risks { kind: assoc; }

    relation r7 @onboarding -> @tour { kind: assoc; }

website/examples/basics/29-concept-map.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.concept-map";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic order-to-cash domain concepts for the concept.map@1 profile.
// Every relation carries an explicit author-written label — verb defaults are rejected (DDN-PJ104).
data domain {
    object order "Order" { kind: entity; }
    object invoice "Invoice" { kind: entity; }
    object payment "Payment" { kind: entity; }
    object ledger "Ledger" { kind: entity; }
    object shipment "Shipment" { kind: entity; }
    relation r1 "bills" @order -> @invoice { kind: assoc; }
    relation r2 "settles" @payment -> @invoice { kind: assoc; }
    relation r3 "posts to" @invoice -> @ledger { kind: assoc; }
    relation r4 "fulfilled by" @order -> @shipment { kind: assoc; }
    relation r5 "books freight to" @shipment -> @ledger { kind: assoc; }
}

format options {
    layout cmap { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; }
}

view concepts "Synthetic order-to-cash concepts / concept map" {
    data: [@domain]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.cmap; spacing: loose;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "concept.map@1"; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/30-epc.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.epc";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic order-to-cash snippet for the epc.basic@1 profile.
// Events (hexagons) and functions (rounded rects) alternate through XOR/AND/OR connectors (circles).
data chain {
    object ev1 "Order received" { kind: "epk.event"; }
    object fn1 "Check stock" { kind: "epk.function"; }
    object ev2 "Stock confirmed" { kind: "epk.event"; }
    object c1 "XOR" { kind: "epk.connector"; x_epc: { operator: "xor" }; }
    object fn2 "Ship order" { kind: "epk.function"; }
    object ev3 "Shipment confirmed" { kind: "epk.event"; }
    object fn3 "Send invoice" { kind: "epk.function"; }
    object ev4 "Invoice paid" { kind: "epk.event"; }
    object fn4 "Record backorder" { kind: "epk.function"; }
    object ev5 "Backorder recorded" { kind: "epk.event"; }
    relation r1 @ev1 -> @fn1 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r2 @fn1 -> @ev2 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r3 @ev2 -> @c1 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r4 @c1 -> @fn2 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r5 @c1 -> @fn4 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r6 @fn2 -> @ev3 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r7 @fn4 -> @ev5 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r8 @ev3 -> @fn3 { kind: "epk.next"; }
    relation r9 @fn3 -> @ev4 { kind: "epk.next"; }
}

format options {
    layout epc { algorithm: layered; }
}

view epc "Synthetic order-to-cash / EPC" {
    data: [@chain]; format: @shared.styles.technical; layout: @options.epc;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "epc.basic@1"; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/31-canvas-pack-a.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.canvas-pack-a";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic coffee-cart business (all data invented) for the canvas.bmc@1 and canvas.lean@1 profiles.
data canvas {
    object bmc_kp "Key partners" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: the bean roaster cooperative and the cart maintenance contractor."; }
    object bmc_ka "Key activities" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: brewing and serving drinks, daily cart setup, and stock ordering."; }
    object bmc_kr "Key resources" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: the cart, the espresso machine, and the two trained baristas."; }
    object bmc_vp "Value propositions" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: a fast specialty coffee at the commuter corner before the first train."; }
    object bmc_cr "Customer relationships" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: remembered orders and a stamp-card loyalty scheme."; }
    object bmc_ch "Channels" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: the physical cart plus pre-orders through a simple chat channel."; }
    object bmc_cs "Customer segments" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: morning commuters and nearby office workers on breaks."; }
    object bmc_cost "Cost structure" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: beans and milk, pitch rent, machine servicing, and wages."; }
    object bmc_rev "Revenue streams" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: per-cup sales and pre-paid weekly commuter bundles."; }
    object lean_problem "Problem" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: commuters queue too long at the station kiosk and miss their train."; }
    object lean_solution "Solution" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: a compact cart with pre-order pickup that serves a coffee in under a minute."; }
    object lean_keymetrics "Key metrics" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: cups served per morning hour and pre-order pickup rate."; }
    object lean_uvp "Unique value proposition" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: specialty coffee faster than the station kiosk, right on the platform path."; }
    object lean_unfair "Unfair advantage" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: an exclusive pitch licence for the busiest commuter corner."; }
    object lean_channels "Channels" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: the cart itself and the pre-order chat channel."; }
    object lean_segments "Customer segments" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: daily commuters and nearby office workers."; }
    object lean_cost "Cost structure" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: supplies, pitch licence, servicing, and staffing."; }
    object lean_revenue "Revenue streams" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: walk-up sales and weekly subscription bundles."; }
}

view bmc "Coffee cart / business model canvas" {
    data: [@canvas];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"canvas.bmc@1"; columns:10; panels:[
        {id:"kp",title:"KEY PARTNERS",row:0,column:0,rowspan:2,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.bmc_kp]},
        {id:"ka",title:"KEY ACTIVITIES",row:0,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.bmc_ka]},
        {id:"kr",title:"KEY RESOURCES",row:1,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.bmc_kr]},
        {id:"vp",title:"VALUE PROPOSITIONS",row:0,column:4,rowspan:2,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.bmc_vp]},
        {id:"cr",title:"CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIPS",row:0,column:6,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.bmc_cr]},
        {id:"ch",title:"CHANNELS",row:1,column:6,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.bmc_ch]},
        {id:"cs",title:"CUSTOMER SEGMENTS",row:0,column:8,rowspan:2,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.bmc_cs]},
        {id:"cost",title:"COST STRUCTURE",row:2,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:5,items:[@canvas.bmc_cost]},
        {id:"rev",title:"REVENUE STREAMS",row:2,column:5,rowspan:1,colspan:5,items:[@canvas.bmc_rev]}]; }
}

view lean "Coffee cart / lean canvas" {
    data: [@canvas];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"canvas.lean@1"; columns:10; panels:[
        {id:"problem",title:"PROBLEM",row:0,column:0,rowspan:2,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.lean_problem]},
        {id:"solution",title:"SOLUTION",row:0,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.lean_solution]},
        {id:"keymetrics",title:"KEY METRICS",row:1,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.lean_keymetrics]},
        {id:"uvp",title:"UNIQUE VALUE PROPOSITION",row:0,column:4,rowspan:2,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.lean_uvp]},
        {id:"unfair",title:"UNFAIR ADVANTAGE",row:0,column:6,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.lean_unfair]},
        {id:"channels",title:"CHANNELS",row:1,column:6,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.lean_channels]},
        {id:"segments",title:"CUSTOMER SEGMENTS",row:0,column:8,rowspan:2,colspan:2,items:[@canvas.lean_segments]},
        {id:"cost",title:"COST STRUCTURE",row:2,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:5,items:[@canvas.lean_cost]},
        {id:"revenue",title:"REVENUE STREAMS",row:2,column:5,rowspan:1,colspan:5,items:[@canvas.lean_revenue]}]; }
}
