ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.canvas-pack-b";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic regional market-entry study (all data invented): the fictional beverage
// brand "Fizzberry" entering the fictional region of "Aurelia", for the
// canvas.pest@1, canvas.pestle@1 and canvas.porter5@1 profiles.
data scan {
    object pest_political "Political" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: Aurelia's stable coalition government is drafting a sugar-tax bill affecting soft drinks."; }
    object pest_economic "Economic" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: disposable income in Aurelia's coastal cities is rising while the currency stays weak against imports."; }
    object pest_social "Social" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: younger Aurelians favor low-sugar craft sodas and reusable packaging."; }
    object pest_technological "Technological" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: mobile ordering covers most urban Aurelian retail, but cold-chain logistics remain patchy inland."; }
    object pestle_political "Political" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: Aurelia's proposed sugar levy would add a per-litre duty on sweetened beverages by next year."; }
    object pestle_economic "Economic" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: regional GDP growth near four percent supports premium pricing despite import-cost pressure."; }
    object pestle_social "Social" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: health-conscious urban consumers are shifting from colas toward botanical sparkling drinks."; }
    object pestle_technological "Technological" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: direct-to-consumer delivery apps reach most of Aurelia's cities within a day."; }
    object pestle_legal "Legal" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: Aurelian labeling law requires front-of-pack sugar warnings and a deposit-return scheme for bottles."; }
    object pestle_environmental "Environmental" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: coastal water-stress rules cap bottling-plant extraction during Aurelia's dry season."; }
    object p5_entrants "Threat of new entrants" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: low bottling capital costs and contract packers make new local soda brands easy to launch."; }
    object p5_supplier "Supplier power" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: two Aurelian bottling-glass works hold most capacity, giving them strong price leverage."; }
    object p5_rivalry "Competitive rivalry" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: three entrenched cola brands discount aggressively each summer in Aurelia's coastal cities."; }
    object p5_buyer "Buyer power" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: Aurelia's two supermarket chains control most shelf space and demand listing fees."; }
    object p5_substitutes "Threat of substitutes" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: tap-water carbonation devices and kombucha stalls are gaining share with Aurelian households."; }
}

view pest "Fizzberry in Aurelia / PEST scan" {
    data: [@scan];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"canvas.pest@1"; columns:4; panels:[
        {id:"political",title:"POLITICAL",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pest_political]},
        {id:"economic",title:"ECONOMIC",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pest_economic]},
        {id:"social",title:"SOCIAL",row:0,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pest_social]},
        {id:"technological",title:"TECHNOLOGICAL",row:0,column:3,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pest_technological]}]; }
}

view pestle "Fizzberry in Aurelia / PESTLE scan" {
    data: [@scan];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"canvas.pestle@1"; columns:3; panels:[
        {id:"political",title:"POLITICAL",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pestle_political]},
        {id:"economic",title:"ECONOMIC",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pestle_economic]},
        {id:"social",title:"SOCIAL",row:0,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pestle_social]},
        {id:"technological",title:"TECHNOLOGICAL",row:1,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pestle_technological]},
        {id:"legal",title:"LEGAL",row:1,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pestle_legal]},
        {id:"environmental",title:"ENVIRONMENTAL",row:1,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.pestle_environmental]}]; }
}

view porter5 "Fizzberry in Aurelia / five forces" {
    data: [@scan];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"canvas.porter5@1"; columns:3; panels:[
        {id:"entrants",title:"THREAT OF NEW ENTRANTS",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.p5_entrants]},
        {id:"supplier",title:"SUPPLIER POWER",row:1,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.p5_supplier]},
        {id:"rivalry",title:"COMPETITIVE RIVALRY",row:1,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.p5_rivalry]},
        {id:"buyer",title:"BUYER POWER",row:1,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.p5_buyer]},
        {id:"substitutes",title:"THREAT OF SUBSTITUTES",row:2,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@scan.p5_substitutes]}]; }
}

website/examples/basics/33-matrix-pack.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/33-matrix-pack.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.matrix-pack";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic product portfolio of the invented beverage company "Fizzberry" (all names
// and data invented) for the matrix.bcg@1, matrix.ansoff@1 and matrix.tows@1 profiles.
// Row/column category elements carry x_category {axis, level}; quadrant cells are
// ordinary assoc relations from a row category to a column category, labeled by name.
data axes {
    object g_high "Market growth: high" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"growth", level:"high"}; description: "Synthetic: fast-growing beverage segments in Fizzberry's markets."; }
    object g_low "Market growth: low" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"growth", level:"low"}; description: "Synthetic: flat or declining beverage segments in Fizzberry's markets."; }
    object s_high "Relative share: high" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"share", level:"high"}; description: "Synthetic: Fizzberry leads the segment versus the largest rival."; }
    object s_low "Relative share: low" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"share", level:"low"}; description: "Synthetic: Fizzberry trails the segment leader."; }
    object m_existing "Market: existing" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"market", level:"existing"}; description: "Synthetic: regions and channels Fizzberry already serves."; }
    object m_new "Market: new" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"market", level:"new"}; description: "Synthetic: regions and channels Fizzberry does not yet serve."; }
    object p_existing "Product: existing" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"product", level:"existing"}; description: "Synthetic: Fizzberry's current beverage lines."; }
    object p_new "Product: new" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"product", level:"new"}; description: "Synthetic: beverage lines Fizzberry has not launched yet."; }
    object int_s "Internal: strength" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"internal", level:"strength"}; description: "Synthetic: brand recognition for botanical sparkling drinks."; }
    object int_w "Internal: weakness" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"internal", level:"weakness"}; description: "Synthetic: limited cold-chain distribution inland."; }
    object ext_o "External: opportunity" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"external", level:"opportunity"}; description: "Synthetic: subscription delivery apps growing in coastal cities."; }
    object ext_t "External: threat" { kind: record; x_category: {axis:"external", level:"threat"}; description: "Synthetic: proposed sugar levy on sweetened beverages."; }
}

data items {
    relation bcg_star "Sparkling tea" @axes.g_high -> @axes.s_high { kind: assoc; }
    relation bcg_star2 "Ginger sparkler" @axes.g_high -> @axes.s_high { kind: assoc; }
    relation bcq_question "Nitro kombucha" @axes.g_high -> @axes.s_low { kind: assoc; }
    relation bcg_cow "Classic cola" @axes.g_low -> @axes.s_high { kind: assoc; }
    relation bcg_dog "Diet cream soda" @axes.g_low -> @axes.s_low { kind: assoc; }
    relation an_penetration "Cola bundle promotion" @axes.m_existing -> @axes.p_existing { kind: assoc; }
    relation an_market_dev "Coastal export launch" @axes.m_new -> @axes.p_existing { kind: assoc; }
    relation an_product_dev "Botanical tonic line" @axes.m_existing -> @axes.p_new { kind: assoc; }
    relation an_diversification "Kombucha subscription box" @axes.m_new -> @axes.p_new { kind: assoc; }
    relation tows_so "Use brand strength in subscription channel" @axes.int_s -> @axes.ext_o { kind: assoc; }
    relation tows_wo "Partner with delivery apps to bypass cold-chain gap" @axes.int_w -> @axes.ext_o { kind: assoc; }
    relation tows_st "Lead low-sugar reformulation ahead of the levy" @axes.int_s -> @axes.ext_t { kind: assoc; }
    relation tows_wt "Hedge sweetener sourcing before levy passes" @axes.int_w -> @axes.ext_t { kind: assoc; }
}

view bcg "Synthetic portfolio / BCG" {
    data: [@axes, @items];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:matrix; profile:"matrix.bcg@1"; rows:[@axes.g_high, @axes.g_low]; columns:[@axes.s_high, @axes.s_low]; relation:"assoc"; value:"name"; duplicates:join; }
}

view ansoff "Synthetic portfolio / Ansoff" {
    data: [@axes, @items];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:matrix; profile:"matrix.ansoff@1"; rows:[@axes.m_existing, @axes.m_new]; columns:[@axes.p_existing, @axes.p_new]; relation:"assoc"; value:"name"; duplicates:join; }
}

view tows "Synthetic portfolio / TOWS" {
    data: [@axes, @items];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:matrix; profile:"matrix.tows@1"; rows:[@axes.int_s, @axes.int_w]; columns:[@axes.ext_o, @axes.ext_t]; relation:"assoc"; value:"name"; duplicates:join; }
}

}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.empathy-scorecard";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Two synthetic studies in one file (all data invented): a support-team empathy
// study for the canvas.empathy@1 profile and a department balanced scorecard for
// the canvas.scorecard@1 profile.
data research {
    object persona "Persona" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic persona: a support agent on the night shift."; }
    object says_a "Says (1)" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: \"I spend half the shift retyping ticket details into the billing tool.\""; }
    object says_b "Says (2)" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: \"Customers forgive an outage when we call them back before they notice.\""; }
    object thinks "Thinks" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: worries that automation metrics reward closing tickets fast, not solving the root cause."; }
    object does "Does" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: keeps a personal spreadsheet of workarounds and shares it with the next shift over chat."; }
    object feels "Feels" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: proud of calm incident handling but drained by the duplicated data entry."; }
    object fin_1 "Financial objective 1" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: cut cost per resolved ticket by twelve percent this year."; }
    object fin_2 "Financial objective 2" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: grow renewal revenue from the existing customer base."; }
    object cus_1 "Customer objective 1" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: raise first-contact resolution above seventy percent."; }
    object cus_2 "Customer objective 2" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: answer every chat within ninety seconds during business hours."; }
    object int_1 "Internal process objective 1" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: automate the ticket-to-billing rekeying step."; }
    object int_2 "Internal process objective 2" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: publish a weekly workaround digest from the shift handover notes."; }
    object lrn_1 "Learning & growth objective 1" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: certify every agent on the new incident playbook by quarter end."; }
    object lrn_2 "Learning & growth objective 2" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic objective: pair each night-shift agent with a day-shift mentor."; }
}

view empathy "Support team / empathy map" {
    data: [@research];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"canvas.empathy@1"; columns:2; panels:[
        {id:"says",title:"SAYS",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.says_a, @research.says_b]},
        {id:"thinks",title:"THINKS",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.thinks]},
        {id:"persona",title:"PERSONA",row:1,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:2,items:[@research.persona]},
        {id:"does",title:"DOES",row:2,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.does]},
        {id:"feels",title:"FEELS",row:2,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.feels]}]; }
}

view scorecard "Department / balanced scorecard" {
    data: [@research];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"canvas.scorecard@1"; columns:2; panels:[
        {id:"financial",title:"FINANCIAL",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.fin_1, @research.fin_2]},
        {id:"customer",title:"CUSTOMER",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.cus_1, @research.cus_2]},
        {id:"internal",title:"INTERNAL PROCESS",row:1,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.int_1, @research.int_2]},
        {id:"learning",title:"LEARNING & GROWTH",row:1,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@research.lrn_1, @research.lrn_2]}]; }
}

website/examples/basics/35-journey-map.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/35-journey-map.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.journey-map";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic product-returns journey (all data invented): four phases, three lanes
// (actions, touchpoints, opportunities) and one full-width emotions band whose
// declared 1..5 values render as a straight-segment polyline (panels.journey@1).
data journey {
    object ph_receive "Receive phase" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic phase goal: the customer sends the unwanted item back with minimal effort."; }
    object ph_inspect "Inspect phase" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic phase goal: the returned item is checked and triaged quickly."; }
    object ph_decide "Decide phase" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic phase goal: a fair refund-or-replace decision is made transparently."; }
    object ph_refund "Refund phase" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic phase goal: money or a replacement reaches the customer without chasing."; }
    object act_receive "Action / receive" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: customer prints the prepaid label and drops the parcel at a corner shop."; }
    object act_inspect "Action / inspect" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: customer waits while the warehouse scans and grades the returned item."; }
    object act_decide "Action / decide" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: customer reads the decision email and accepts the proposed refund."; }
    object act_refund "Action / refund" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: customer sees the refund land on the original card and archives the receipt."; }
    object tp_receive "Touchpoint / receive" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: returns portal with order lookup and a QR code for the drop-off point."; }
    object tp_inspect "Touchpoint / inspect" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: tracking page shows the parcel arrived and inspection has started."; }
    object tp_decide "Touchpoint / decide" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: decision email explains the outcome with photos from the inspection."; }
    object tp_refund "Touchpoint / refund" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: bank statement line and a closing confirmation message in the portal."; }
    object opp_receive "Opportunity / receive" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic opportunity: prefill the returns form from the order history to cut retyping."; }
    object opp_inspect "Opportunity / inspect" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic opportunity: publish typical inspection times so waiting feels predictable."; }
    object opp_decide "Opportunity / decide" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic opportunity: offer a one-click appeal path when a refund is declined."; }
    object opp_refund "Opportunity / refund" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic opportunity: instant refund to wallet instead of a five-day card settlement."; }
    object em_receive "Emotion / receive" { kind: record; x_record: {"phase": "receive", "value": 2, "description": "Synthetic: annoyed that the item failed, mildly relieved the return label was easy."}; }
    object em_inspect "Emotion / inspect" { kind: record; x_record: {"phase": "inspect", "value": 3, "description": "Synthetic: neutral while waiting, reassured by the visible tracking updates."}; }
    object em_decide "Emotion / decide" { kind: record; x_record: {"phase": "decide", "value": 4, "description": "Synthetic: pleased the decision arrived with clear evidence and no argument."}; }
    object em_refund "Emotion / refund" { kind: record; x_record: {"phase": "refund", "value": 5, "description": "Synthetic: delighted the refund landed ahead of the promised date."}; }
}

view returns "Returns journey / synthetic" {
    data: [@journey];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"panels.journey@1"; columns:4; panels:[
        {id:"phase-receive",title:"RECEIVE",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.ph_receive]},
        {id:"phase-inspect",title:"INSPECT",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.ph_inspect]},
        {id:"phase-decide",title:"DECIDE",row:0,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.ph_decide]},
        {id:"phase-refund",title:"REFUND",row:0,column:3,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.ph_refund]},
        {id:"actions-receive",title:"ACTIONS",row:1,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.act_receive]},
        {id:"actions-inspect",title:"ACTIONS",row:1,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.act_inspect]},
        {id:"actions-decide",title:"ACTIONS",row:1,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.act_decide]},
        {id:"actions-refund",title:"ACTIONS",row:1,column:3,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.act_refund]},
        {id:"touchpoints-receive",title:"TOUCHPOINTS",row:2,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.tp_receive]},
        {id:"touchpoints-inspect",title:"TOUCHPOINTS",row:2,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.tp_inspect]},
        {id:"touchpoints-decide",title:"TOUCHPOINTS",row:2,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.tp_decide]},
        {id:"touchpoints-refund",title:"TOUCHPOINTS",row:2,column:3,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.tp_refund]},
        {id:"opportunities-receive",title:"OPPORTUNITIES",row:3,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.opp_receive]},
        {id:"opportunities-inspect",title:"OPPORTUNITIES",row:3,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.opp_inspect]},
        {id:"opportunities-decide",title:"OPPORTUNITIES",row:3,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.opp_decide]},
        {id:"opportunities-refund",title:"OPPORTUNITIES",row:3,column:3,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@journey.opp_refund]},
        {id:"emotions",title:"EMOTIONS (1..5)",row:4,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:4,items:[@journey.em_receive, @journey.em_inspect, @journey.em_decide, @journey.em_refund]}]; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.story-map";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic shop-rebuild story map (all data invented): five ordered backbone
// activities as columns and two releases as rows (top = first release). Cells are
// declared analysis.task story objects carried by assoc relations with x_story.task;
// two stories share the r1 × checkout cell, exercising duplicates:join.
data shop {
    object browse "Browse catalogue" { kind: "analysis.task"; description: "Synthetic backbone activity: the shopper explores the catalogue."; }
    object configure "Configure item" { kind: "analysis.task"; description: "Synthetic backbone activity: the shopper configures the chosen item."; }

website/examples/basics/37-crows-foot-erd.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.crows-foot";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic orders/customers/invoices schema (all data invented) demonstrating the
// erd.crowfoot@1 profile: every ref relation carries obligatory crow's-foot
// source_mark/target_mark cardinality drawn from one, zeroone, many, zeromany.

data sales {
    object customer "Customer" {
        kind: table;
        fields {
            field customer_id { key: primary; }
            field display_name;
        }
    }
    object purchase "Purchase" {
        kind: table;
        fields {
            field purchase_id { key: primary; }
            field customer_id;
        }
    }
    object invoice "Invoice" {
        kind: table;
        fields {
            field invoice_id { key: primary; }
            field purchase_id;
        }
    }
    object line "Invoice line" {
        kind: table;
        fields {
            field line_id { key: primary; }
            field invoice_id;
        }
    }
    relation r_places "places" @customer -> @purchase {
        kind: ref;
        source_mark: one;
        target_mark: zeromany;
        enforcement: database;
    }
    relation r_billed "billed as" @purchase -> @invoice {
        kind: ref;
        source_mark: one;
        target_mark: zeroone;
        enforcement: database;
    }
    relation r_lists "lists" @invoice -> @line {
        kind: ref;
        source_mark: one;
        target_mark: many;
        enforcement: database;
    }
    relation r_customer_fk "purchase customer" @purchase.customer_id -> @customer.customer_id {
        kind: ref;
        source_mark: zeromany;
        target_mark: one;
        enforcement: database;
    }
}

view erd "Synthetic sales / crow's-foot ERD" {
    data: [@sales];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:graph; profile:"erd.crowfoot@1"; }
    // Organic placement spreads the four tables around the relation flow; the
    // crow's-foot marks and relation labels carry the semantics, so the legend
    // is switched off.
    layout { algorithm: organic; }
    chrome { legend: off; }
    publication {size: content; fit: none; overflow: error;}
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.sql-ddl";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;
data shop {
 object customer "Customer" { kind: table; fields { field customer_id { key: primary; } field display_name; } }
 object purchase "Purchase" { kind: table; fields { field purchase_id { key: primary; } field customer_id; field ordered_on; } }
 object note "Review note" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic DDL export example; not a deployable schema."; }
 relation purchase_customer "purchase belongs to customer" @purchase.customer_id -> @customer.customer_id { kind: ref; source_mark: zeromany; target_mark: one; enforcement: database; }
 relation note_customer "note annotates customer" @note -> @customer { kind: note; }
}
view publish "Synthetic shop / approved SQL DDL" {
 data: [@shop];
 format: @shared.styles.technical;
 export {
  mode: redacted;
  format: sql;
  identifier_mode: preserve;
  elements: [@shop.customer, @shop.purchase, @shop.note];
  fields: [@shop.customer.customer_id, @shop.customer.display_name, @shop.purchase.purchase_id, @shop.purchase.customer_id, @shop.purchase.ordered_on];
  properties: [kind, key];
  title: "Synthetic shop DDL";
 }
 publication {size: content; fit: none; overflow: error;}
}

website/examples/basics/39-pyramid.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.pyramid";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic support-tier pyramid (all data invented) demonstrating the
// panels.pyramid@1 profile: four trapezoid bands stacked widest-at-bottom,
// centered band labels, and side annotations on the annotated bands. The top
// band declares no items, which is legal only under panels.pyramid@1.
data tier_notes {
    object ann_community "Community channel" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: documentation and forum deflect most questions."; }
    object ann_standard "Standard channel" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: email channel with next-day target."; }
    object ann_priority "Priority channel" { kind: note; description: "Synthetic: named queue with four-hour target."; }
}

view tiers "Support tiers / pyramid" {
    data: [@tier_notes];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:panels; profile:"panels.pyramid@1"; columns:1; panels:[
        {id:"dedicated",title:"DEDICATED ENGINEER",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1},
        {id:"priority",title:"PRIORITY SUPPORT",row:1,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@tier_notes.ann_priority]},
        {id:"standard",title:"STANDARD SUPPORT",row:2,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@tier_notes.ann_standard]},
        {id:"community",title:"COMMUNITY & SELF-SERVICE",row:3,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@tier_notes.ann_community]}]; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.sequence";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic three-party order flow for the uml.sequence@1 profile.
// Participants are lifelines in declaration order; uml.message relations are
// numbered messages top-to-bottom in declaration order. reserve_stock_reply is
// a dashed return (x_return); audit_log is a self-message on checkout.
// All data is synthetic. This is profile-level coverage, not UML conformance.
data flow {
    object customer_app "Customer app" { kind: "application"; }
    object checkout "Checkout" { kind: "service"; }
    object inventory "Inventory" { kind: "service"; }
    relation submit_order "Submit order" @customer_app -> @checkout { kind: "uml.message"; }
    relation reserve_stock "Reserve stock" @checkout -> @inventory { kind: "uml.message"; }
    relation reserve_stock_reply "Stock reserved" @inventory -> @checkout { kind: "uml.message"; x_return: true; }
    relation audit_log "Audit log" @checkout -> @checkout { kind: "uml.message"; }
    relation confirm "Confirm order" @checkout -> @customer_app { kind: "uml.message"; }
}

view sequence "Synthetic order flow / sequence" {
    data: [@flow]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: sequence; profile: "uml.sequence@1"; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

module "ddn.examples.communication";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic three-party order flow for the uml.communication@1 profile.
// Same model shape as the sequence view (41-sequence-diagram.ddn), rendered as
// a graph: participants are nodes, uml.message relations are edges labelled
// with their author-declared sequence number (x_message.seq). Replies
// (x_return) are dotted under their request: reserve_stock is 2, its reply is
// 2.1. audit_log is a self-message on checkout.
// All data is synthetic. This is profile-level coverage, not UML conformance.
data flow {
    object customer_app "Customer app" { kind: "application"; }
    object checkout "Checkout" { kind: "service"; }
    object inventory "Inventory" { kind: "service"; }
    relation submit_order "Submit order" @customer_app -> @checkout { kind: "uml.message"; x_message: { seq: "1"; }; }
    relation reserve_stock "Reserve stock" @checkout -> @inventory { kind: "uml.message"; x_message: { seq: "2"; }; }
    relation reserve_stock_reply "Stock reserved" @inventory -> @checkout { kind: "uml.message"; x_return: true; x_message: { seq: "2.1"; }; }
    relation audit_log "Audit log" @checkout -> @checkout { kind: "uml.message"; x_message: { seq: "3"; }; }
    relation confirm "Confirm order" @checkout -> @customer_app { kind: "uml.message"; x_message: { seq: "4"; }; }
}

view communication "Synthetic order flow / communication" {
    data: [@flow]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "uml.communication@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.object";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic object/instance snapshot for the uml.object@1 profile.
// Classifiers Customer and Order are ordinary uml.class objects with declared
// fields. Instances sample_customer and sample_order are kind:record objects
// naming their classifier via x_instance; their slot fields must match the
// classifier's field names (DDN-PJ112). One assoc link connects the two
// instances. Slots render as the graph renderer's native field rows.
// All data is synthetic. This is profile-level coverage, not UML conformance.
data model {
    object customer "Customer" { kind: "uml.class";
        fields {
            field customer_id { datatype: "string"; }
            field name { datatype: "string"; }
        }
    }
    object order "Order" { kind: "uml.class";
        fields {
            field order_id { datatype: "string"; }
            field total { datatype: "number"; }
        }
    }
    object sample_customer "sample_customer : Customer" {
        kind: record; x_instance: { classifier: @model.customer; };
        fields {
            field customer_id "C-1001";
            field name "Ada Example";
        }
    }
    object sample_order "sample_order : Order" {
        kind: record; x_instance: { classifier: @model.order; };
        fields {
            field order_id "O-4711";
            field total "129.50";
        }
    }
    relation placed "Placed" @sample_customer -> @sample_order { kind: assoc; }
}

view objects "Synthetic snapshot / objects" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "uml.object@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/44-hierarchical-state.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.hierarchicalstate";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic hierarchical state machine for the state.composite@1 profile.
// An order lifecycle with top-level states draft and closed, plus a composite
// state fulfillment drawn as a frame containing substates. Two parallel regions
// (payment, packing) are dashed frames inside the composite; each region has
// its own initial/final pair. Transitions are ordinary state.transition
// relations with event labels; one crosses the composite boundary
// (paid -> closed). All data is synthetic. This is profile-level coverage,
// not UML/SCXML conformance.
data order {
    object start "Start" { kind: "state.initial"; }
    object draft "Draft" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object fulfillment "Fulfillment" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object closed "Closed" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object done "Done" { kind: "state.final"; }

    object payment_initial "Payment start" { kind: "state.initial"; }
    object awaiting "Awaiting payment" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object paid "Paid" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object payment_final "Payment done" { kind: "state.final"; }

    object packing_initial "Packing start" { kind: "state.initial"; }
    object open "Open box" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object packed "Packed" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object packing_final "Packing done" { kind: "state.final"; }

    relation begin "begin" @start -> @draft { kind: "state.transition"; }
    relation submit "submit" @draft -> @fulfillment { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "submit" }; }
    relation pay "pay" @payment_initial -> @awaiting { kind: "state.transition"; }
    relation paid_ev "paid" @awaiting -> @paid { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "payment_received" }; }
    relation payment_end "payment end" @paid -> @payment_final { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "reconcile" }; }
    relation pack_start "pack start" @packing_initial -> @open { kind: "state.transition"; }

    relation ship "ship" @paid -> @closed { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "shipped" }; }
    relation finish "finish" @closed -> @done { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "archive" }; }
}

ddn "0.5";

module "ddn.examples.hierarchicalstate";
// Synthetic hierarchical state machine for the state.composite@1 profile.
// An order lifecycle with top-level states draft and closed, plus a composite
// state fulfillment drawn as a frame containing substates. Two parallel regions
// (payment, packing) are dashed frames inside the composite; each region has
// its own initial/final pair. Transitions are ordinary state.transition
// relations with event labels; one crosses the composite boundary
// (paid -> closed). All data is synthetic. This is profile-level coverage,
// not UML/SCXML conformance.
data order {
    object start "Start" { kind: "state.initial"; }
    object draft "Draft" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object fulfillment "Fulfillment" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object closed "Closed" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object done "Done" { kind: "state.final"; }

    object payment_initial "Payment start" { kind: "state.initial"; }
    object awaiting "Awaiting payment" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object paid "Paid" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object payment_final "Payment done" { kind: "state.final"; }

    object packing_initial "Packing start" { kind: "state.initial"; }
    object open "Open box" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object packed "Packed" { kind: "state.state"; }
    object packing_final "Packing done" { kind: "state.final"; }

    relation begin "begin" @start -> @draft { kind: "state.transition"; }
    relation submit "submit" @draft -> @fulfillment { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "submit" }; }
    relation pay "pay" @payment_initial -> @awaiting { kind: "state.transition"; }
    relation paid_ev "paid" @awaiting -> @paid { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "payment_received" }; }
    relation payment_end "payment end" @paid -> @payment_final { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "reconcile" }; }
    relation pack_start "pack start" @packing_initial -> @open { kind: "state.transition"; }
    relation packed_ev "packed" @open -> @packed { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "box_sealed" }; }
    relation packing_end "packing end" @packed -> @packing_final { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "label_printed" }; }
    relation ship "ship" @paid -> @closed { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "shipped" }; }
    relation finish "finish" @closed -> @done { kind: "state.transition"; x_transition: { "event": "archive" }; }
}

view lifecycle "Order lifecycle / composite states" {
    data: [@order]; format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "state.composite@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    frame fulfillment "FULFILLMENT" { scope: @order.fulfillment;
        members: [@order.fulfillment, @order.awaiting, @order.paid, @order.open, @order.packed]; }
    frame payment "PAYMENT" { x_region: true;
        members: [@order.payment_initial, @order.awaiting, @order.paid, @order.payment_final]; }
    frame packing "PACKING" { x_region: true;
        members: [@order.packing_initial, @order.open, @order.packed, @order.packing_final]; }
}

website/examples/basics/45-activity-diagram.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.activitydiagram";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic activity-style flow for the uml.activity@1 profile.
// An order-fulfilment activity with two swimlane partitions (webshop,
// warehouse) drawn as view frames; lane membership is declared per node with
// x_partition:{lane:"..."}. A flow.forkjoin fork splits the flow into
// pick_items, take_payment and the order object node; a matching join
// reunites them before end. All edges are uml.flow. All data is synthetic.
// This is profile-level coverage, not UML conformance.
data order {
    object start "Start" { kind: "flow.start"; x_partition: { "lane": "webshop" }; }
    object fork "Fork" { kind: "flow.forkjoin"; x_partition: { "lane": "warehouse" }; }
    object pick_items "Pick items" { kind: "flow.process"; x_partition: { "lane": "warehouse" }; }
    object take_payment "Take payment" { kind: "flow.process"; x_partition: { "lane": "webshop" }; }
    object order_obj "Order" { kind: "flow.objectnode"; x_partition: { "lane": "warehouse" }; }
    object join "Join" { kind: "flow.forkjoin"; x_partition: { "lane": "warehouse" }; }
    object end "End" { kind: "flow.end"; x_partition: { "lane": "webshop" }; }

    relation begin "begin" @start -> @fork { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation to_pick "to pick" @fork -> @pick_items { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation to_pay "to pay" @fork -> @take_payment { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation to_order "to order" @fork -> @order_obj { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation picked "picked" @pick_items -> @join { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation paid "paid" @take_payment -> @join { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation order_ready "order ready" @order_obj -> @join { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation finish "finish" @join -> @end { kind: "uml.flow"; }
}

view fulfilment "Order fulfilment activity" {
    data: [@order]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "uml.activity@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    frame webshop "Webshop" { members: [@order.start, @order.take_payment, @order.end]; }
    frame warehouse "Warehouse" { members: [@order.fork, @order.pick_items, @order.order_obj, @order.join]; }
}

website/examples/basics/46-bpmn.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.bpmn";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic BPMN-style collaboration for the bpmn.basic@1 profile.
// Two pools (buyer, seller) are view frames with x_pool:true. Sequence flow
// inside each pool uses uml.flow (RT-105); start/end events carry
// x_event:{type:...}; the gateway carries x_gateway:{type:"exclusive"} and
// renders with an "X" name marker. One dashed bpmn.messageflow crosses the
// pools from request_quote to prepare_quote. All data is synthetic.
// This is profile-level coverage, not BPMN conformance.
data quote {
    object start "Start" { kind: "flow.start"; x_event: { "type": "none" }; }
    object request_quote "Request quote" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object decide "Quote acceptable?" { kind: "flow.gateway"; x_gateway: { "type": "exclusive" }; }
    object failed "Quote rejected" { kind: "flow.end"; x_event: { "type": "error" }; }

    object receive "Request received" { kind: "flow.start"; x_event: { "type": "message" }; }
    object prepare_quote "Prepare quote" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object sent "Quote sent" { kind: "flow.end"; x_event: { "type": "message" }; }

    relation begin "begin" @start -> @request_quote { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation review "review" @request_quote -> @decide { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation reject "reject" @decide -> @failed { kind: "uml.flow"; }

    relation intake "intake" @receive -> @prepare_quote { kind: "uml.flow"; }
    relation deliver "deliver" @prepare_quote -> @sent { kind: "uml.flow"; }

    relation request "quote request" @request_quote -> @prepare_quote { kind: "bpmn.messageflow"; }
}

view collaboration "Buyer / seller collaboration" {
    data: [@quote]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "bpmn.basic@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    frame buyer "Buyer" { x_pool: true; members: [@quote.start, @quote.request_quote, @quote.decide, @quote.failed]; }
    frame seller "Seller" { x_pool: true; members: [@quote.receive, @quote.prepare_quote, @quote.sent]; }
}

module "ddn.examples.timing";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic traffic-light timing for the uml.timing@1 profile.
// One band per participant in declaration order; x_states entries are
// {at, state} time points — "from `at` onward the participant is in `state`
// until the next entry". Time is an abstract numeric axis (seconds here).
// All data is synthetic. This is profile-level coverage, not UML conformance.
data signals {
    object controller "Controller" { kind: "application";
        x_states: [{at: 0, state: "red"}, {at: 25, state: "green"}, {at: 55, state: "amber"}];
    }
    object pedestrian_signal "Pedestrian signal" { kind: "application";
        x_states: [{at: 0, state: "wait"}, {at: 25, state: "walk"}, {at: 45, state: "wait"}];
    }
}

view timing "Synthetic traffic lights / timing (seconds)" {
    data: [@signals]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: timing; profile: "uml.timing@1"; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

// profile. The `overview` view is a flowchart whose `pay` and `ship` steps
// reference the detail views `payment_flow` and `stock_flow` declared in the
// same file, via x_subdiagram:{view:"<local view id>"} — a plain string, not
// a @-reference. Referenced views are not expanded inline (reference
// semantics only). All edges are flow.next. All data is synthetic.
// This is profile-level coverage, not UML conformance.
data checkout {
    object start "Start" { kind: "flow.start"; }
    object browse "Browse catalogue" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object pay "Pay" { kind: "flow.process"; x_subdiagram: { view: "payment_flow" }; }
    object ship "Ship order" { kind: "flow.process"; x_subdiagram: { view: "stock_flow" }; }
    object end "End" { kind: "flow.end"; }

    relation to_browse "to browse" @start -> @browse { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation to_pay "to pay" @browse -> @pay { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation to_ship "to ship" @pay -> @ship { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation to_end "to end" @ship -> @end { kind: "flow.next"; }
}

data payment {
    object authorize "Authorize card" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object capture "Capture funds" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    relation authorized "authorized" @authorize -> @capture { kind: "flow.next"; }
}

data stock {
    object reserve "Reserve stock" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object dispatch "Dispatch parcel" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    relation reserved "reserved" @reserve -> @dispatch { kind: "flow.next"; }
}

view overview "Checkout interaction overview" {
    data: [@checkout]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "uml.interaction_overview@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view payment_flow "Payment flow detail" {

    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }

    projection { kind: graph; profile: "ddn@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/49-cmmn.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.cmmn";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic CMMN-style case diagram for the cmmn.basic@1 profile.
// A stage is a cmmn.stage object plus a view frame whose scope resolves to it
// and whose members are the stage's plan items. Sentries are cmmn.sentry
// diamonds declared as members of the stage frame, typed by
// x_sentry:{on:"entry"|"exit"}. Milestones are rounded cmmn.milestone nodes;
// tasks reuse analysis.task; ordering uses analysis.precedes. All data is
// synthetic. This is profile-level coverage, not CMMN conformance.
data claim {
    object review "Review" { kind: "cmmn.stage"; }
    object gather_documents "Gather documents" { kind: "analysis.task"; }
    object assess_claim "Assess claim" { kind: "analysis.task"; }
    object docs_received "Docs received?" { kind: "cmmn.sentry"; x_sentry: { "on": "entry" }; }
    object claim_decided "Claim decided" { kind: "cmmn.milestone"; }

    relation order "order" @gather_documents -> @assess_claim { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation done "done" @assess_claim -> @claim_decided { kind: "assoc"; }
}

view case "Claim handling" {
    data: [@claim]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "cmmn.basic@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    frame review_frame "Review" { scope: @claim.review; members: [@claim.gather_documents, @claim.assess_claim, @claim.docs_received]; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.sysml";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic SysML-style block views for the sysml.bdd@1 / sysml.ibd@1 /
// sysml.parametric@1 profiles. Blocks are sysml.block objects; under the ibd
// view they declare a ports {} group and a sysml.flow relation carries the
// item ("water") between the typed ports pump.out and reservoir.in — the
// renderer draws a small square at each port attachment on the block border.
// The parametric view shows a sysml.constraint whose label carries the
// formula text, bound to exactly two endpoints (the two blocks) via assoc
// relations. All data is synthetic. This is profile-level coverage, not
// SysML conformance.
data m {
    object pump "Pump" { kind: "sysml.block";
        ports { port out { direction: out; } }
    }
    object reservoir "Reservoir" { kind: "sysml.block";
        ports { port in { direction: in; } }
    }
    object flow_balance "{flow = pressure × area}" { kind: "sysml.constraint"; }

    relation feeds "feeds" @pump -> @reservoir { kind: "assoc"; }
    relation water "water" @pump.out -> @reservoir.in { kind: "sysml.flow"; }
    relation bind_pump "binds pump" @flow_balance -> @pump { kind: "assoc"; }
    relation bind_reservoir "binds reservoir" @flow_balance -> @reservoir { kind: "assoc"; }
}

view bdd "Pump station block definition" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "sysml.bdd@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    exclude: [@m.flow_balance];
}

view ibd "Pump station internal block" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "sysml.ibd@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    exclude: [@m.flow_balance];
}

view parametric "Pump station flow balance" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "sysml.parametric@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.archimate";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic ArchiMate-style layered view for the archimate.basic@1 profile.
// Three layers — business (governance family), application (interface
// family), technology (deployment family) — coloured from the registered
// family palette. archi.rel serving links point upward only: technology
// serves application serves business; downward links are rejected as
// DDN-PJ123. The business_viewpoint view is a viewpoint as a named view
// (select of the business-layer objects only). All data is synthetic. This
// is profile-level coverage, not ArchiMate conformance.
data m {
    object service_agent "Service agent" { kind: "archi.business_actor"; }
    object order_desk "Order desk" { kind: "archi.business_role"; }
    object order_handling "Order handling" { kind: "archi.business_process"; }
    object order_api "Order API" { kind: "archi.application_component"; }
    object order_service "Order service" { kind: "archi.application_service"; }
    object db_node "Database node" { kind: "archi.technology_node"; }
    object db_service "Database service" { kind: "archi.technology_service"; }

    relation staffing "staffs" @service_agent -> @order_desk { kind: "archi.rel"; }
    relation handling "runs" @order_desk -> @order_handling { kind: "archi.rel"; }
    relation serving_process "serves" @order_service -> @order_handling { kind: "archi.rel"; }
    relation exposed_on "realised by" @order_service -> @order_api { kind: "archi.rel"; }
    relation serving_app "serves" @db_service -> @order_api { kind: "archi.rel"; }
    relation hosted_on "hosted on" @db_service -> @db_node { kind: "archi.rel"; }
}

view landscape "Order platform landscape" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "archimate.basic@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: up; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view business_viewpoint "Order platform business viewpoint" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "archimate.basic@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    select: [@m.service_agent, @m.order_desk, @m.order_handling];
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.pertcpm";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic PERT/CPM critical-path view for the pert.cpm@1 profile.
// Six tasks with declared day estimates (x_estimate) and finish-before
// dependencies (analysis.precedes). The planner computes the forward pass
// (ES/EF) and backward pass (LS/LF) on the dependency DAG; the zero-slack
// critical chain design -> build_ui -> integrate -> test -> ship (13 days)
// is drawn with the theme accent stroke, and every task name carries its
// estimate and slack. build_api carries 1 day of slack. All data is
// synthetic.
data m {
    object design "Design" { kind: "analysis.task"; x_estimate: 3; }
    object build_api "Build API" { kind: "analysis.task"; x_estimate: 4; }
    object build_ui "Build UI" { kind: "analysis.task"; x_estimate: 5; }
    object integrate "Integrate" { kind: "analysis.task"; x_estimate: 2; }
    object test "Test" { kind: "analysis.task"; x_estimate: 2; }
    object ship "Ship" { kind: "analysis.task"; x_estimate: 1; }

    relation d_api "before" @design -> @build_api { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation d_ui "before" @design -> @build_ui { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation api_int "before" @build_api -> @integrate { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation ui_int "before" @build_ui -> @integrate { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation int_test "before" @integrate -> @test { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation test_ship "before" @test -> @ship { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
}

view plan "Release plan" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "pert.cpm@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/53-fault-event-tree.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/53-fault-event-tree.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.faulteventtree";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic fault tree and event tree for the fault.tree@1 / event.tree@1
// profiles. Gates are tree.gate diamonds with a declared x_gate.type
// (and/or); basic events are tree.event circles; tree.input edges point from
// a gate to each of its inputs. Fault view: an OR top gate "outage" with one
// AND gate "power_cut" (UPS failed AND grid failed) plus switch, cable and
// operator-error events. Event view: a small OR gate "alarm" followed
// forward to smoke-detection and sprinkler-trip outcomes. All data is
// synthetic.
data m {
    object outage "OR outage" { kind: "tree.gate"; x_gate: { type: "or" }; }
    object power_cut "AND power_cut" { kind: "tree.gate"; x_gate: { type: "and" }; }
    object ups_failed "UPS failed" { kind: "tree.event"; }
    object grid_failed "Grid failed" { kind: "tree.event"; }
    object switch_failed "Switch failed" { kind: "tree.event"; }
    object cable_cut "Cable cut" { kind: "tree.event"; }
    object operator_error "Operator error" { kind: "tree.event"; }

    relation i1 "has input" @outage -> @power_cut { kind: "tree.input"; }
    relation i2 "has input" @outage -> @switch_failed { kind: "tree.input"; }
    relation i3 "has input" @outage -> @cable_cut { kind: "tree.input"; }
    relation i4 "has input" @power_cut -> @ups_failed { kind: "tree.input"; }
    relation i5 "has input" @power_cut -> @grid_failed { kind: "tree.input"; }

    object alarm "OR alarm" { kind: "tree.gate"; x_gate: { type: "or" }; }
    object smoke_detected "Smoke detected" { kind: "tree.event"; }
    object sprinkler_trip "Sprinkler trip" { kind: "tree.event"; }

    relation e1 "has input" @alarm -> @smoke_detected { kind: "tree.input"; }
    relation e2 "has input" @alarm -> @sprinkler_trip { kind: "tree.input"; }
}

view fault "Service outage fault tree" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    select: [@m.outage, @m.power_cut, @m.ups_failed, @m.grid_failed, @m.switch_failed, @m.cable_cut, @m.operator_error];
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "fault.tree@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: tree; direction: down; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view event "Alarm event tree" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    select: [@m.alarm, @m.smoke_detected, @m.sprinkler_trip];
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "event.tree@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: tree; direction: down; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/54-network-diagram.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.networkdiagram";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Synthetic office network for the network.basic@1 / network.rack@1
// profiles. The bus is an ordinary network.bus node (sized wide and thin
// with a place pin) — declared membership, not routing geometry; the
// DDN046 junction/shared-trunk guards are untouched. network.attaches
// edges point from a device to the bus (the file server attaches via its
// eth0 port member) and from the uplink router to the switch. The rack
// view frames rack_a (4U) with the two servers as members carrying
// declared x_rack.unit slot numbers, pinned bottom-up. All data is
// synthetic; glyphs are original DDN line art.
data m {
    object office_bus "Office bus" { kind: "network.bus"; }
    object core_switch "Core switch" { kind: "network.switch";
        ports { port wan { direction: in; } }
    }
    object file_server "File server" { kind: "network.server"; x_rack: { unit: 1 };
        ports { port eth0 { direction: out; } }
    }
    object app_server "App server" { kind: "network.server"; x_rack: { unit: 3 };
        ports { port eth0 { direction: out; } }
    }
    object uplink "Uplink router" { kind: "router"; }
    object rack_a "Rack A" { kind: "network.rack"; x_rack: { units: 4 }; }

    relation attach_switch "attaches to" @core_switch -> @office_bus { kind: "network.attaches"; }
    relation attach_file "attaches to" @file_server.eth0 -> @office_bus { kind: "network.attaches"; }
    relation attach_app "attaches to" @app_server -> @office_bus { kind: "network.attaches"; }
    relation attach_uplink "attaches to" @uplink -> @core_switch.wan { kind: "network.attaches"; }
}

view lan "Office LAN" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    select: [@m.office_bus, @m.core_switch, @m.file_server, @m.app_server, @m.uplink];
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "network.basic@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: down; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    place @m.office_bus { size: [420px, 28px]; }
}

view rack "Rack A elevation" {
    data: [@m]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    select: [@m.file_server, @m.app_server];
    projection { kind: graph; profile: "network.rack@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: down; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
    frame rack_a_frame "Rack A (4U)" { scope: @m.rack_a; members: [@m.file_server, @m.app_server]; }
    place @m.file_server { at: [0px, 264px]; }
    place @m.app_server { at: [0px, 88px]; }
}

module "ddn.examples.wireframe";

// Synthetic settings-screen mock for the wireframe.ui@1 profile. The
// screen area is a ui.frame object; the contained controls are members of
// a view frame scoped to it. Drawn as plain rect variants in the classic
// look with the neutral grey palette — clean low-fi boxes, not a widget
// toolkit. All data is synthetic.
data m {
    object settings "Settings" { kind: "ui.frame"; }
    object profile_label "Profile" { kind: "ui.label"; }
    object display_name "Display name" { kind: "ui.input"; }
    object email_notifications "Email notifications" { kind: "ui.checkbox"; }
    object timezone_list "Timezone" { kind: "ui.list";
        fields { field utc; field berlin; field tokyo; }
    }
    object avatar_placeholder "Avatar" { kind: "ui.image"; }
    object save_button "Save" { kind: "ui.button"; }
}

view settings "Settings screen" {
    data: [@m];
    select: [@m.profile_label, @m.display_name, @m.email_notifications, @m.timezone_list, @m.avatar_placeholder, @m.save_button];
    projection { profile: "wireframe.ui@1"; }
    style { theme: neutral; }

}
website/examples/basics/56-family-tree.ddn

website/examples/basics/56-family-tree.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.familytree";

// Fictional three-generation family for the family.tree@1 profile.
// Partnerships join through small family.union nodes: alex and miriam via
// union_am, sam and jo via union_sj. family.parent_of edges run from a
// union down to a child, so the layered downward layout stacks the
// generations — grandparents' union at the top, the child generation
// below, the grandchild at the bottom. Persons carry optional x_birth
// (and one x_death) years. All persons and dates are fictional.
data m {
    object alex "Alex" { kind: "family.person"; x_birth: 1948; x_death: 2019; }
    object miriam "Miriam" { kind: "family.person"; x_birth: 1951; }
    object union_am { kind: "family.union"; }
    object sam "Sam" { kind: "family.person"; x_birth: 1976; }
    object jo "Jo" { kind: "family.person"; x_birth: 1978; }
    object union_sj { kind: "family.union"; }
    object robin "Robin" { kind: "family.person"; x_birth: 2005; }

    relation partner_alex "partner of" @alex -> @union_am { kind: "family.partner_of"; }
    relation partner_miriam "partner of" @miriam -> @union_am { kind: "family.partner_of"; }
    relation partner_sam "partner of" @sam -> @union_sj { kind: "family.partner_of"; }
    relation partner_jo "partner of" @jo -> @union_sj { kind: "family.partner_of"; }
    relation child_sam "parent of" @union_am -> @sam { kind: "family.parent_of"; }
    relation child_robin "parent of" @union_sj -> @robin { kind: "family.parent_of"; }
}

view family "Three generations" {
    data: [@m];
    select: [@m.alex, @m.miriam, @m.union_am, @m.sam, @m.jo, @m.union_sj, @m.robin];
    projection { profile: "family.tree@1"; }
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: down; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
}

website/examples/basics/57-element-defaults.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.element-defaults";
import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// B1-002: every element kind carries a registry-driven default property set
// (standard/registry/catalogue.json kinds[].defaults). A bare declaration
// renders with exactly those defaults implicit; an explicit property always
// wins over the registry default. `cache` defaults to role: "cache".
data model {
    object bare "Bare cache (registry default role)" { kind: cache; }
    object explicit "Explicit override wins" { kind: cache; role: primary; description: "role is stated in source, overriding the registry default role: cache."; }
}

view defaults "Element defaults / bare versus explicit" {
    data: [@model];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    publication { width: 1600px; height: 1000px; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/58-css-hooks.ddn

website/examples/basics/58-css-hooks.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.css-hooks";

// CSS class hooks: every rendered SVG mark carries deterministic classes
// (ddn-svg / ddn-node ddn-kind-* / ddn-rel ddn-verb-* / ddn-field / ddn-label /
// ddn-frame / ddn-panel / ddn-mark ddn-mark-*), so a web page can restyle a
// diagram with its own stylesheet. Script-level look/format/object
// declarations keep winning on the elements they name: the audit node is
// declared kind: cache, so a page rule for .ddn-kind-tbl never matches it.
// See the companion 58-css-hooks.html for the live page-CSS demonstration.

data shop {
    object orders "Orders" { kind: table; fields { field order_id { key: primary; } field status; } }
    object invoices "Invoices" { kind: table; fields { field invoice_id { key: primary; } field total; } }
    object audit "Audit cache" { kind: cache; description: "Script-level kind choice: page CSS on .ddn-kind-tbl does not apply here."; }
    relation billed @orders -> @invoices { kind: publish; }
    relation cached @invoices -> @audit { kind: capture; }
}

view hooks "CSS hooks / page styling" {
    data: [@shop];
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
    frame billing "BILLING" { members: [@shop.orders, @shop.invoices]; }
}
website/examples/basics/59-data-refresh.ddn

website/examples/basics/59-data-refresh.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.data-refresh";

// Data refresh (B1-006, keyed transactional contract B1-029): a host page
// swaps the records of the `metrics` data block with
// ws.replaceData("metrics", [...]) and re-renders — the model, views and
// layout structure stay untouched. Records match by their `key` field (the
// declaration id), so reordered payloads never corrupt identities. Replacing
// with the same values re-renders every view byte-identical; replacing with
// new values moves only the chart marks. The chart below binds records
// explicitly (explicit membership), so added records are reported via
// DDN-W015 addedRecordsNotVisible instead of appearing silently, and removing
// a bound record is rejected transactionally; the dependency graph selects
// the whole block (selector membership) and picks up additions automatically.
// See examples/embed/data-refresh.html.
//
//   ws.replaceData("metrics", rows);   // rows: plain objects, optional key,
//   const r = ws.renderSync({entry, view: "latency_chart"});  // same fields
//   host.innerHTML = r.svg;            // as the first record

data metrics {
    object m1 "Alpha" { kind: record; x_record: { label: "Alpha", value: 10, unit: "ms" }; }
    object m2 "Beta" { kind: record; x_record: { label: "Beta", value: 20, unit: "ms" }; }
    object m3 "Gamma" { kind: record; x_record: { label: "Gamma", value: 15, unit: "ms" }; }
    relation trend "Alpha drives Beta" @m1 -> @m2 { kind: flow; }
    relation feed "Beta feeds Gamma" @m2 -> @m3 { kind: flow; }
}

view latency_chart "Latency / chart" {
    data: [@metrics];
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@metrics.m1, @metrics.m2, @metrics.m3]; mark: bar; x: "x_record.label"; y: "x_record.value"; unit: "ms"; width: 900px; height: 560px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
}

view dependency_graph "Latency / dependency graph" {
    data: [@metrics];
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
}

website/examples/basics/61-self-contained.ddn

website/examples/basics/61-self-contained.ddn

ddn "0.5";

// RFC-117: a full design in one self-contained file. Three module sections —
// model, data, views — no imports at all. Sibling sections reference each
// other by module-qualified id (@shop.data.records), exactly as separate
// files would through an import alias.

module "shop.model";

format styles {
    notation core;
    style classic;
    layout wires { algorithm: grid; gap: 80px; }
    display detailed;
    publication screen { size: content; width: 1360px; height: 860px; margin: 30px; overflow: warn; }
    legend words { width: 280px; }
    bundle technical {
        notation: @core;
        style: @classic;
        layout: @wires;
        display: @detailed;
        publication: @screen;
        legend: @words;
    }
}

module "shop.data";

data records "Shop records" {
    object customer "Customer" {
        kind: table;
        role: authoritative;
        fields {
            field customer_id { key: primary; }
            field display_name;
        }
    }
    object order "Order" {
        kind: table;
        fields {
            field order_id { key: primary; }
            field customer_id;
            field ordered_at;
        }
    }
    relation order_customer "Customer places orders" @order.customer_id -> @customer.customer_id {
        kind: references;
        source_mark: zeromany;
        target_mark: one;
    }
    sample customers "Synthetic customers" {
        mode: synthetic;
        columns: [@customer.customer_id, @customer.display_name];
        rows: [["C001", "Customer A"], ["C002", "Customer B"]];
    }
}

module "shop.views";

view overview "Self-contained / overview" {
    data: [@shop.data.records];
    format: @shop.model.styles.technical;
}

view compact "Self-contained / compact" {
    data: [@shop.data.records];
    format: @shop.model.styles.technical;
    display { fields: none; }
}

website/examples/basics/70-motion-relations.ddn — multi-file workspace (2 files)

website/examples/basics/70-motion-relations.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.motion";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// B1-033 motion showcase: declarative SMIL animation on graph relations.
// - orders -> queue: single travelling marker (defaults: circle, 8px, 60px/s)
// - queue -> worker: staggered particle stream (rate: 6) — traffic-style flow
// - worker -> ledger: pulse variant (edge stroke colour/opacity, no marker)
// The exported SVG animates autonomously; the unified tool's Animation drawer
// starts/stops, steps one hop, and re-times playback. --no-motion renders the
// same diagram static for print.
data pipeline {
    object orders "Order intake" { kind: topic; fields { field order_id; field placed_at; } }
    object queue "Dispatch queue" { kind: queue; fields { field order_id; field priority; } }
    object worker "Fulfilment worker" { kind: activity; }
    object ledger "Fulfilled orders" { kind: table; fields { field order_id; field fulfilled_at; } }
    relation submit "Orders submitted" @orders -> @queue { kind: flow; motion: flow; }
    relation dispatch "Dispatch stream" @queue -> @worker { kind: flow; motion: flow; marker: square; marker_size: 10; rate: 6; speed: 140; marker_color: "#B45309"; }
    relation record "Record fulfilment" @worker -> @ledger { kind: flow; motion: pulse; pulse_color: "#0E7490"; }
}

view animated "Order pipeline / motion showcase" {
    data: [@pipeline];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    legend { placement: bottom; }
}

website/examples/basics/71-flow-traces.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.flow-trace";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// B1-033 flow blocks: step-traceable multi-hop motion sequences. Each flow
// resolves its steps to the existing relations between consecutive elements
// and renders one marker hopping the concatenated route paths; the unified
// tool's Animation drawer steps a selected flow exactly one hop at a time.
// Two flows over one model demonstrate the flow selector.
data shop {
    object client "Storefront" { kind: application; }
    object cart "Cart service" { kind: service; }
    object payment "Payment gateway" { kind: service; }
    object orders "Order store" { kind: table; fields { field order_id; field total; } }
    object warehouse "Warehouse" { kind: activity; }
    relation checkout "Checkout" @client -> @cart { kind: flow; }
    relation charge "Charge card" @cart -> @payment { kind: flow; }
    relation persist "Persist order" @cart -> @orders { kind: flow; }
    relation fulfil "Release to fulfilment" @orders -> @warehouse { kind: flow; }
}

view traces "Checkout / multi-hop flow traces" {
    data: [@shop];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    flow purchase "Purchase path" {
        steps: @shop.client -> @shop.cart -> @shop.payment;
        marker: circle; marker_color: "#B91C1C"; speed: 90;
    }
    flow fulfilment "Fulfilment path" {
        steps: @shop.client -> @shop.cart -> @shop.orders -> @shop.warehouse;
        marker: square; marker_color: "#1D4ED8"; speed: 70; rate: 2;
    }
    legend { placement: bottom; }
}

website/examples/basics/72-iso-charts.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.iso-charts";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Isometric depth (B1-034): the optional ddn-iso module extrudes chart marks
// when a view declares iso: true or a depth. `depth: "x_record.load"` binds the
// extrusion thickness to the record payload (the chart binding idiom), so a
// host driving ws.replaceData(...) grows/shrinks the 3D depth on refresh
// (see examples/embed/iso-load-monitor.html). All data is synthetic.
// Without ddn-iso.js the same views render flat with a coded diagnostic —
// an iso:true view degrades to a visible placeholder plus DDN-E010.

data capacity {
    object web "Web tier" { kind: record; x_record: { tier: "Web", value: 420, load: 26, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object api "API tier" { kind: record; x_record: { tier: "API", value: 610, load: 34, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object db "Database tier" { kind: record; x_record: { tier: "Database", value: 380, load: 18, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object cache "Cache tier" { kind: record; x_record: { tier: "Cache", value: 240, load: 12, unit: "req/s" }; }
}

view iso_bar "Synthetic tier throughput / iso bar" {
    data: [@capacity]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:chart; profile:"chart.basic@1"; records:[@capacity.web, @capacity.api, @capacity.db, @capacity.cache]; mark:bar; x:"x_record.tier"; y:"x_record.value"; unit:"req/s"; iso:true; depth:"x_record.load"; width:1120px; height:640px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view iso_pie "Synthetic tier share / iso pie" {
    data: [@capacity]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:chart; profile:"chart.basic@1"; records:[@capacity.web, @capacity.api, @capacity.db, @capacity.cache]; mark:pie; x:"x_record.tier"; y:"x_record.value"; unit:"req/s"; iso:true; depth:22px; width:1120px; height:640px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view iso_donut "Synthetic tier share / iso donut" {
    data: [@capacity]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:chart; profile:"chart.basic@1"; records:[@capacity.web, @capacity.api, @capacity.db, @capacity.cache]; mark:donut; x:"x_record.tier"; y:"x_record.value"; unit:"req/s"; iso:true; depth:22px; width:1120px; height:640px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view iso_area "Synthetic tier throughput / iso area ribbon" {
    data: [@capacity]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:chart; profile:"chart.basic@1"; records:[@capacity.web, @capacity.api, @capacity.db, @capacity.cache]; mark:area; x:"x_record.tier"; y:"x_record.value"; unit:"req/s"; iso:true; depth:16px; width:1120px; height:640px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

view iso_treemap "Synthetic tier throughput / iso treemap blocks" {
    data: [@capacity]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:chart; profile:"chart.treemap@1"; records:[@capacity.web, @capacity.api, @capacity.db, @capacity.cache]; mark:treemap; x:"x_record.tier"; y:"x_record.value"; unit:"req/s"; iso:true; depth:20px; width:1120px; height:640px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

// Multi-series iso (B1-036): series:/arrangement: views plan through the quality
// renderer (chart.quality@1), which extrudes with the same ddn-iso primitives —
// one column per series point, each series on its own depth plane so faces never
// z-fight. Without ddn-iso.js this view degrades exactly like the others.
data throughput {
    object a_q1 "Line A / Q1" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q1", line: "Line A", value: 420, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object a_q2 "Line A / Q2" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q2", line: "Line A", value: 510, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object a_q3 "Line A / Q3" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q3", line: "Line A", value: 460, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object a_q4 "Line A / Q4" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q4", line: "Line A", value: 610, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object b_q1 "Line B / Q1" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q1", line: "Line B", value: 300, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object b_q2 "Line B / Q2" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q2", line: "Line B", value: 360, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object b_q3 "Line B / Q3" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q3", line: "Line B", value: 330, unit: "req/s" }; }
    object b_q4 "Line B / Q4" { kind: record; x_record: { quarter: "Q4", line: "Line B", value: 410, unit: "req/s" }; }
}

view iso_multiseries_bar "Synthetic line throughput / iso multi-series bar" {
    data: [@throughput]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:chart; profile:"chart.quality@1"; records:[@throughput.a_q1, @throughput.a_q2, @throughput.a_q3, @throughput.a_q4, @throughput.b_q1, @throughput.b_q2, @throughput.b_q3, @throughput.b_q4]; mark:bar; x:"x_record.quarter"; y:"x_record.value"; series:"x_record.line"; arrangement:group; unit:"req/s"; iso:true; depth:18px; width:1120px; height:640px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: error; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/73-iso-architecture.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.iso-architecture";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// Isometric diagram nodes (B1-034, stage 2): iso: true on a graph view renders
// every node as an extruded prism on an isometric ground plane; per-object
// `depth` overrides the view depth (building heights differ). Relations are
// routed flat by the ordinary engine and then projected onto the ground
// plane — routing is never computed in 3D. All systems are synthetic.

data platform {
    object client "Client app" { kind: activity; depth: 14px; workload: "interactive"; }
    object cdn "Edge CDN" { kind: queue; depth: 22px; workload: "edge"; }
    object gateway "API gateway" { kind: topic; depth: 34px; workload: "serving"; }
    object orders "Orders service" { kind: activity; depth: 46px; workload: "serving"; }
    object ledger "Ledger store" { kind: table; depth: 58px; workload: "system-of-record"; }
    relation r1 "HTTPS" @client -> @cdn { kind: flow; }
    relation r2 "forwards" @cdn -> @gateway { kind: flow; }
    relation r3 "routes" @gateway -> @orders { kind: flow; }
    relation r4 "persists" @orders -> @ledger { kind: flow; }
}

view iso_map "Synthetic platform tiers / isometric" {
    data: [@platform]; format: @shared.styles.technical;
    projection { kind:graph; profile:"ddn@1"; iso:true; depth:18px; }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; overflow: warn; minimum_text: 8pt; }
}

website/examples/basics/74-reusable-presets.ddn

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.examples.reuse";

import "shared.ddn" as shared;

// B1-041 author-controlled reuse: named field groups, relation property sets,
// motion presets and include-by-reference fragments. Definitions are top-level
// templates; `use:` applications expand to exactly the handwritten inline
// form (local properties override presets; expanded identities are as if
// declared inline). `version: N` on a definition is documentary only.

fields audited {
    version: 1;
    created_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
    updated_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
}

relation_props governed {
    enforcement: database;
    x_owner: "data-governance";
}

preset gentle_pulse {
    motion: pulse;
    pulse_color: "#0E7490";
    speed: 60;
}

preset trace_style {
    marker: square;
    marker_color: "#1D4ED8";
    speed: 80;
    rate: 2;
}

fragment audit_log {
    table audit_log "Audit log" {
        fields {
            created_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
            updated_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
            event { datatype: "text"; }
        }
    }
}

data model {
    use: @audit_log;
    table customer "Customer" {
        fields {
            use: @audited;
            customer_id { key: primary; datatype: "uuid"; }
            display_name "Display name";
        }
    }
    table order "Order" {
        fields {
            use: @audited;
            order_id { key: primary; datatype: "uuid"; }
            customer_id { datatype: "uuid"; }
        }
    }
    queue events "Order events" {}
    // A relation property set: governed assertions without repetition.
    ref places "places" @order.customer_id [zeromany] -> @customer.customer_id [one] { use: @governed; }
    ref logs "logs to" @customer -> @audit_log { use: @governed; }
    // A motion preset: B1-033 animation properties reused across relations.
    transfers_to notifies "notifies" @order -> @events { use: @gentle_pulse; }
}

view reuse "Reusable presets / customer orders" {
    data: [@model];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    legend { placement: bottom; }
}

view traced "Reusable presets / event trace" {
    data: [@model];
    format: @shared.styles.technical;
    flow order_path "Order path" {
        use: @trace_style;
        steps: @model.order -> @model.customer -> @model.audit_log;
    }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
}
