website/examples/basics/74-reusable-presets.combined.ddn (combined single-file variant — renders identically)

ddn "0.5";

module "ddn.examples.reuse";
// B1-041 author-controlled reuse: named field groups, relation property sets,
// motion presets and include-by-reference fragments. Definitions are top-level
// templates; `use:` applications expand to exactly the handwritten inline
// form (local properties override presets; expanded identities are as if
// declared inline). `version: N` on a definition is documentary only.

fields audited {
    version: 1;
    created_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
    updated_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
}

relation_props governed {
    enforcement: database;
    x_owner: "data-governance";
}

preset gentle_pulse {
    motion: pulse;
    pulse_color: "#0E7490";
    speed: 60;
}

preset trace_style {
    marker: square;
    marker_color: "#1D4ED8";
    speed: 80;
    rate: 2;
}

fragment audit_log {
    table audit_log "Audit log" {
        fields {
            created_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
            updated_at { datatype: "timestamp"; }
            event { datatype: "text"; }
        }
    }
}

data model {
    use: @audit_log;
    table customer "Customer" {
        fields {
            use: @audited;
            customer_id { key: primary; datatype: "uuid"; }
            display_name "Display name";
        }
    }
    table order "Order" {
        fields {
            use: @audited;
            order_id { key: primary; datatype: "uuid"; }
            customer_id { datatype: "uuid"; }
        }
    }
    queue events "Order events" {}
    // A relation property set: governed assertions without repetition.
    ref places "places" @order.customer_id [zeromany] -> @customer.customer_id [one] { use: @governed; }
    ref logs "logs to" @customer -> @audit_log { use: @governed; }
    // A motion preset: B1-033 animation properties reused across relations.
    transfers_to notifies "notifies" @order -> @events { use: @gentle_pulse; }
}

view reuse "Reusable presets / customer orders" {
    data: [@model];
    format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical;
    legend { placement: bottom; }
}

view traced "Reusable presets / event trace" {
    data: [@model];
    format: @ddn.examples.shared.styles.technical;
    flow order_path "Order path" {
        use: @trace_style;
        steps: @model.order -> @model.customer -> @model.audit_log;
    }
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
}

module "ddn.examples.shared";
format styles {
    notation core;
    style classic;
    style hand { look: handDrawn; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }
    style neo { look: neo; }
    style dark { theme: dark; }
    style neutral { theme: neutral; font: mono; }
    style forest { look: handDrawn; theme: forest; font: handwriting; roughness: 1.8; hachure: true; }
    layout wires { algorithm: grid; gap: 80px; }
    display detailed;
    display compact { fields: none; maturity: none; badges: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; width: 1360px; height: 860px; margin: 30px; overflow: warn; }
    publication paper { size: a4; orientation: landscape; margin: 8mm; minimum_text: 7pt; overflow: warn; }
    legend words { width: 280px; }
    legend numbers { mode: numbers; width: 280px; }
    bundle technical {
        notation: @core;
        style: @classic;
        layout: @wires;
        display: @detailed;
        publication: @screen;
        legend: @words;
    }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.gallery.layouts";

// Gallery layout sheet. A small holding-company hierarchy rendered once per
// placement algorithm accepted by the runtime (native grid/manual/layered/
// tree/mindmap/grouped plus the pattern-based fit_grid/circular/radial/
// spanning_tree/organic).
data model {
    object holding "Meridian Holdings" { kind: context; role: group; }
    object energy "Meridian Energy" { kind: application; role: core; }
    object freight "Meridian Freight" { kind: application; role: core; }
    object media "Meridian Media" { kind: application; role: support; }
    object wind "Wind operations" { kind: process; role: core; }
    object solar "Solar operations" { kind: process; role: core; }
    relation own_e @holding -> @energy { kind: assoc; }
    relation own_f @holding -> @freight { kind: assoc; }
    relation own_m @holding -> @media { kind: assoc; }
    relation split_w @energy -> @wind { kind: assoc; }
    relation split_s @energy -> @solar { kind: assoc; }
}

format gallery {
    style standard;
    display readable { fields: none; badges: none; maturity: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; fit: none; }
    legend key { width: 260px; }
}

view grid "Layouts / grid" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: grid; columns: 3; }
}
view manual "Layouts / manual (pinned)" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: manual; }
    place @model.holding { at: [400px,0px]; }
    place @model.energy { at: [0px,240px]; }
    place @model.freight { at: [400px,240px]; }
    place @model.media { at: [800px,240px]; }
    place @model.wind { at: [0px,480px]; }
    place @model.solar { at: [400px,480px]; }
}
view layered "Layouts / layered" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; direction: right; }
}
view tree "Layouts / tree" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: tree; root: @model.holding; hierarchy: [assoc]; }
}
view mindmap "Layouts / mindmap" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: mindmap; root: @model.holding; hierarchy: [assoc]; routing: curved; }
}
view grouped "Layouts / grouped" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: grouped; group_by: role; columns: 2; }
}
view fit_grid "Layouts / fit_grid" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: fit_grid; }
}
view circular "Layouts / circular" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: circular; }
}
view radial "Layouts / radial" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: radial; root: @model.holding; }
}
view spanning_tree "Layouts / spanning_tree" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: spanning_tree; root: @model.holding; }
}
view organic "Layouts / organic" {
    data: [@model]; style: @gallery.standard; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: organic; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.gallery.looks";

// Gallery look/palette sheet. One small order-to-cash graph rendered in every
// look (classic, handDrawn, neo) crossed with every palette theme
// (default, neutral, dark, night, forest, base).
data model {
    object customer "Customer" { kind: actor; }
    object storefront "Online storefront" { kind: application; }
    object orders "Order service" { kind: application; }
    object ledger "Sales ledger" { kind: table; fields { field order_id; field amount; } }
    object warehouse "Warehouse dispatch" { kind: process; }
    relation places @customer -> @storefront { kind: assoc; }
    relation confirms @storefront -> @orders { kind: assoc; }
    relation posts @orders -> @ledger { kind: assoc; }
    relation ships @orders -> @warehouse { kind: assoc; }
}

format gallery {
    layout flow_right { algorithm: layered; gap: 120px; row_gap: 110px; }
    display readable { badges: none; maturity: none; }

}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.gallery.marks";

// Gallery chart-mark sheet. Every mark renders over a small real dataset:
// synthetic quarterly generation figures for a two-site wind/solar operator.
data quarterly {
    object q1 "Q1 / Wind" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q1", "source": "Wind", "mwh": 412, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object q2 "Q2 / Wind" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q2", "source": "Wind", "mwh": 355, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object q3 "Q3 / Wind" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q3", "source": "Wind", "mwh": 388, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object q4 "Q4 / Wind" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q4", "source": "Wind", "mwh": 470, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object s1 "Q1 / Solar" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q1", "source": "Solar", "mwh": 180, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object s2 "Q2 / Solar" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q2", "source": "Solar", "mwh": 296, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object s3 "Q3 / Solar" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q3", "source": "Solar", "mwh": 310, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object s4 "Q4 / Solar" { kind: record; x_record: {"quarter": "Q4", "source": "Solar", "mwh": 205, "unit": "MWh"}; }
}

data criteria {
    object r1 "Wind / Capacity factor" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Wind farm", "criterion": "Capacity factor", "score": 8, "unit": "points"}; }
    object r2 "Wind / Grid access" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Wind farm", "criterion": "Grid access", "score": 6, "unit": "points"}; }
    object r3 "Wind / Land cost" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Wind farm", "criterion": "Land cost", "score": 5, "unit": "points"}; }
    object r4 "Wind / Permitting" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Wind farm", "criterion": "Permitting", "score": 4, "unit": "points"}; }
    object r5 "Wind / Maintenance" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Wind farm", "criterion": "Maintenance", "score": 7, "unit": "points"}; }
    object v1 "Solar / Capacity factor" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Solar park", "criterion": "Capacity factor", "score": 6, "unit": "points"}; }
    object v2 "Solar / Grid access" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Solar park", "criterion": "Grid access", "score": 7, "unit": "points"}; }
    object v3 "Solar / Land cost" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Solar park", "criterion": "Land cost", "score": 6, "unit": "points"}; }
    object v4 "Solar / Permitting" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Solar park", "criterion": "Permitting", "score": 8, "unit": "points"}; }
    object v5 "Solar / Maintenance" { kind: record; x_record: {"site": "Solar park", "criterion": "Maintenance", "score": 9, "unit": "points"}; }
}

data pipeline {
    object p1 "Prospects" { kind: record; x_record: {"stage": "Prospects", "count": 240, "unit": "accounts"}; }
    object p2 "Qualified" { kind: record; x_record: {"stage": "Qualified", "count": 150, "unit": "accounts"}; }
    object p3 "Proposal" { kind: record; x_record: {"stage": "Proposal", "count": 90, "unit": "accounts"}; }
    object p4 "Negotiation" { kind: record; x_record: {"stage": "Negotiation", "count": 48, "unit": "accounts"}; }
    object p5 "Signed" { kind: record; x_record: {"stage": "Signed", "count": 26, "unit": "accounts"}; }
}

data uptime {
    object u1 "Fleet availability" { kind: record; x_record: {"kpi": "Fleet availability", "value": 96.4, "unit": "%"}; }
}

data market {
    object d1 "Mon" { kind: record; x_record: {"day": "Mon", "open": 42.1, "high": 43.8, "low": 41.5, "close": 43.2, "unit": "EUR"}; }
    object d2 "Tue" { kind: record; x_record: {"day": "Tue", "open": 43.2, "high": 44.0, "low": 42.4, "close": 42.9, "unit": "EUR"}; }
    object d3 "Wed" { kind: record; x_record: {"day": "Wed", "open": 42.9, "high": 44.6, "low": 42.8, "close": 44.3, "unit": "EUR"}; }
    object d4 "Thu" { kind: record; x_record: {"day": "Thu", "open": 44.3, "high": 45.1, "low": 43.6, "close": 43.9, "unit": "EUR"}; }
    object d5 "Fri" { kind: record; x_record: {"day": "Fri", "open": 43.9, "high": 45.4, "low": 43.7, "close": 45.0, "unit": "EUR"}; }
}

data storage {
    object t1 "Turbine logs" { kind: record; x_record: {"path": "operations/turbine-logs", "gb": 320, "unit": "GB"}; }
    object t2 "SCADA archive" { kind: record; x_record: {"path": "operations/scada-archive", "gb": 540, "unit": "GB"}; }
    object t3 "Meter reads" { kind: record; x_record: {"path": "billing/meter-reads", "gb": 210, "unit": "GB"}; }
    object t4 "Invoices" { kind: record; x_record: {"path": "billing/invoices", "gb": 80, "unit": "GB"}; }
    object t5 "Weather feeds" { kind: record; x_record: {"path": "forecast/weather-feeds", "gb": 260, "unit": "GB"}; }
    object t6 "Model runs" { kind: record; x_record: {"path": "forecast/model-runs", "gb": 150, "unit": "GB"}; }
}

data flows {
    object f1 "Wind to grid" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "Wind farm", "target": "Grid export", "mwh": 1240, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f2 "Solar to grid" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "Solar park", "target": "Grid export", "mwh": 780, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f3 "Solar to storage" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "Solar park", "target": "Battery", "mwh": 211, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f4 "Storage to grid" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "Battery", "target": "Grid export", "mwh": 190, "unit": "MWh"}; }
    object f5 "Wind to curtailment" { kind: record; x_record: {"source": "Wind farm", "target": "Curtailment", "mwh": 62, "unit": "MWh"}; }
}

format gallery {
    publication screen { size: content; fit: none; }
    bundle common { publication: @screen; }
}

view mark_bar "Chart marks / bar" {
    format: @gallery.common; data: [@quarterly];
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@quarterly.q1, @quarterly.q2, @quarterly.q3, @quarterly.q4, @quarterly.s1, @quarterly.s2, @quarterly.s3, @quarterly.s4]; mark: bar; x: "x_record.quarter"; y: "x_record.mwh"; series: "x_record.source"; unit: "MWh"; width: 1050px; height: 640px; }
}
view mark_line "Chart marks / line" {
    format: @gallery.common; data: [@quarterly];
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@quarterly.q1, @quarterly.q2, @quarterly.q3, @quarterly.q4, @quarterly.s1, @quarterly.s2, @quarterly.s3, @quarterly.s4]; mark: line; x: "x_record.quarter"; y: "x_record.mwh"; series: "x_record.source"; unit: "MWh"; width: 1050px; height: 640px; }
}
view mark_area "Chart marks / area" {
    format: @gallery.common; data: [@quarterly];
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@quarterly.q1, @quarterly.q2, @quarterly.q3, @quarterly.q4, @quarterly.s1, @quarterly.s2, @quarterly.s3, @quarterly.s4]; mark: area; x: "x_record.quarter"; y: "x_record.mwh"; series: "x_record.source"; unit: "MWh"; width: 1050px; height: 640px; }
}
view mark_point "Chart marks / point" {
    format: @gallery.common; data: [@quarterly];
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@quarterly.q1, @quarterly.q2, @quarterly.q3, @quarterly.q4, @quarterly.s1, @quarterly.s2, @quarterly.s3, @quarterly.s4]; mark: point; x: "x_record.quarter"; y: "x_record.mwh"; series: "x_record.source"; unit: "MWh"; width: 1050px; height: 640px; }

view mark_pie "Chart marks / pie" {
    format: @gallery.common; data: [@quarterly];
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@quarterly.q1, @quarterly.q2, @quarterly.q3, @quarterly.q4]; mark: pie; x: "x_record.quarter"; y: "x_record.mwh"; unit: "MWh"; width: 1050px; height: 640px; }

view mark_donut "Chart marks / donut" {
    format: @gallery.common; data: [@quarterly];
    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.basic@1"; records: [@quarterly.q1, @quarterly.q2, @quarterly.q3, @quarterly.q4]; mark: donut; x: "x_record.quarter"; y: "x_record.mwh"; unit: "MWh"; width: 1050px; height: 640px; }
}
view mark_radar "Chart marks / radar" {

    projection { kind: chart; profile: "chart.radar@1"; records: [@criteria.r1, @criteria.r2, @criteria.r3, @criteria.r4, @criteria.r5, @criteria.v1, @criteria.v2, @criteria.v3, @criteria.v4, @criteria.v5]; mark: radar; x: "x_record.criterion"; y: "x_record.score"; series: "x_record.site"; unit: "points"; width: 1050px; height: 640px; }

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.gallery.routing";

// Gallery routing sheet. The same publication pipeline graph rendered in every
// routing mode (orthogonal, straight, curved-bezier, curved-rounded) crossed
// with every look (classic, handDrawn, neo).
data model {
    object manuscript "Manuscript intake" { kind: process; }
    object review "Peer review" { kind: process; }
    object edit "Copy editing" { kind: process; }
    object typeset "Typesetting" { kind: process; }
    object archive "Digital archive" { kind: table; }
    relation submit @manuscript -> @review { kind: assoc; }
    relation revise "returns for revision" @review -> @manuscript { kind: assoc; }
    relation accept @review -> @edit { kind: assoc; }
    relation compose @edit -> @typeset { kind: assoc; }
    relation publish @typeset -> @archive { kind: assoc; }
    relation reference @edit -> @archive { kind: assoc; }
}

data model_straight {
    object manuscript "Manuscript intake" { kind: process; }
    object review "Peer review" { kind: process; }
    object edit "Copy editing" { kind: process; }
    object typeset "Typesetting" { kind: process; }
    object archive "Digital archive" { kind: table; }
    relation submit @manuscript -> @review { kind: assoc; }
    relation revise "returns for revision" @review -> @manuscript { kind: assoc; }
    relation accept @review -> @edit { kind: assoc; }
    relation compose @edit -> @typeset { kind: assoc; }
    relation publish @typeset -> @archive { kind: assoc; }
}

format gallery {
    layout flow_right { algorithm: layered; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
    display readable { fields: none; badges: none; maturity: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; fit: none; }
    legend key { width: 260px; }
}

view orthogonal_classic "Routing / orthogonal × classic" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: orthogonal; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
}
view straight_classic "Routing / straight × classic" {
    data: [@model_straight]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: straight; gap: 260px; row_gap: 240px; }
}
view curved_classic "Routing / curved bezier × classic" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; curve: bezier; curve_tension: 0.5; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
}
view rounded_classic "Routing / rounded × classic" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; curve: rounded; curve_radius: 32px; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
}
view orthogonal_handdrawn "Routing / orthogonal × handDrawn" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: orthogonal; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
    style { look: handDrawn; }
}
view straight_handdrawn "Routing / straight × handDrawn" {
    data: [@model_straight]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: straight; gap: 260px; row_gap: 240px; }
    style { look: handDrawn; }
}
view curved_handdrawn "Routing / curved bezier × handDrawn" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; curve: bezier; curve_tension: 0.5; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
    style { look: handDrawn; }
}
view rounded_handdrawn "Routing / rounded × handDrawn" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; curve: rounded; curve_radius: 32px; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
    style { look: handDrawn; }
}
view orthogonal_neo "Routing / orthogonal × neo" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: orthogonal; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
    style { look: neo; }
}
view straight_neo "Routing / straight × neo" {
    data: [@model_straight]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: straight; gap: 260px; row_gap: 240px; }
    style { look: neo; }
}
view curved_neo "Routing / curved bezier × neo" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; curve: bezier; curve_tension: 0.5; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }
    style { look: neo; }
}
view rounded_neo "Routing / rounded × neo" {
    data: [@model]; display: @gallery.readable; publication: @gallery.screen; legend: @gallery.key;
    layout { algorithm: layered; routing: curved; curve: rounded; curve_radius: 32px; gap: 150px; row_gap: 130px; }

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.gallery.spacing";

// Gallery spacing sheet. One library-lending graph rendered at each spacing
// level (tight, normal, loose, expanded).
data model {
    object member "Library member" { kind: actor; }
    object catalogue "Catalogue search" { kind: application; }
    object loans "Loans register" { kind: table; fields { field loan_id; field due_date; } }
    object notices "Overdue notices" { kind: process; }
    relation searches @member -> @catalogue { kind: assoc; }
    relation borrows "borrows a copy recorded in the loans register" @member -> @loans { kind: assoc; }
    relation flags "flags overdue loans for the notice run" @loans -> @notices { kind: assoc; }
}

format gallery {
    style standard;
    layout flow_right { algorithm: layered; }
    display readable { badges: none; maturity: none; }
    publication screen { size: content; fit: none; }
    legend key { width: 260px; }
    bundle common { style: @standard; layout: @flow_right; display: @readable; publication: @screen; legend: @key; }
}

view tight "Spacing / tight" {
    data: [@model]; format: @gallery.common; spacing: tight;
}
view normal "Spacing / normal" {
    data: [@model]; format: @gallery.common; spacing: normal;
}
view loose "Spacing / loose" {
    data: [@model]; format: @gallery.common; spacing: loose;
}
view expanded "Spacing / expanded" {
    data: [@model]; format: @gallery.common; spacing: expanded;
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.live.adaptive-lab";
// Presentation-only routing laboratory. No physical operations are executed.
// Default placement is automatic. place.at and route.via remain hard hints.
data pipeline {
    object client "Order entry" { kind: application; }
    object validate "Validate order" { kind: activity; }
    object catalog "Product catalogue" { kind: table;
        fields { field product_id { key: primary; } field description; field sellable; }
    }
    object stock "Inventory reserve" { kind: activity; }
    object orders "Accepted orders" { kind: table;
        fields { field order_id { key: primary; } field customer_id; field accepted_at; field row_version; }
    }
    object events "Order events" { kind: topic; }
    object reports "Sales projection" { kind: table; workload: [olap]; role: derived;
        fields { field order_id; field business_date; field net_amount; }
    }
    relation submit "Submit proposed order" @client -> @validate { kind: flow; }
    relation lookup "Check product status" @validate -> @catalog { kind: depends; }
    relation reserve "Request stock reservation" @validate -> @stock { kind: flow; }
    relation persist "Record accepted order" @stock -> @orders { kind: flow; }
    relation publish "Publish outbox event" @orders -> @events { kind: flow; }
    relation project "Build sales projection" @events -> @reports { kind: flow; }
}
data ports {
    object n0 "Sales application" { kind: application; }
    object n1 "Customer service" { kind: application; }
    object n2 "Order service" { kind: application; }
    object n3 "Reporting" { kind: application; }
    object n4 "Warehouse" { kind: application; }
    object n5 "Integration hub" { kind: application; }
    relation r0 "Order event" @n2 -> @n5 { kind: flow; }
    relation r1 "Customer update" @n5 -> @n1 { kind: flow; }
    relation r2 "Warehouse summary" @n4 -> @n3 { kind: flow; }
    relation r3 "Acknowledgement" @n5 -> @n0 { kind: flow; }
}
data movement {
    object n0 "Request handler" { kind: application; }
    object n1 "Client" { kind: application; }
    object n2 "Projection service" { kind: application; }
    object n3 "Gateway" { kind: application; }
    object n4 "Database" { kind: application; }
    object n5 "Middleware" { kind: application; }
    relation r0 "Dispatch request" @n3 -> @n0 { kind: flow; }
    relation r1 "Forward request" @n5 -> @n3 { kind: flow; }
    relation r2 "Persist projection" @n2 -> @n4 { kind: flow; }
    relation r3 "Submit command" @n1 -> @n5 { kind: flow; }
}
data locked {
    object left "Source A" { kind: application; }
    object right "Destination A" { kind: application; }
    object top "Source B" { kind: application; }
    object bottom "Destination B" { kind: application; }
    relation horizontal "Independent transfer A" @left -> @right { kind: flow; }
    relation vertical "Independent dependency B" @top -> @bottom { kind: depends; }
}
data blockers {
    object a "Order lines" { kind: table; fields { field customer_id; } }
    object b "Unrelated dataset" { kind: table; fields { field audit_id; } }
    object c "Customers" { kind: table; fields { field customer_id { key: primary; } } }
    relation a_c "Logical customer reference" @a.customer_id -> @c.customer_id { kind: ref; enforcement: undecided; }
}
format shared {
    style night { theme: night; }
    layout adaptive { gap: 90px; }
    layout grid_seed { algorithm: grid; }
    display details { maturity: none; }
    legend numbered { mode: numbers; width: 320px; }
    publication page { size: content; fit: none; }
    bundle technical { style: @night; layout: @adaptive; display: @details; legend: @numbered; publication: @page; }
}
view automatic "Adaptive order flow / no positional coordinates" {
    legend { keys: {"pipeline.submit": 1, "pipeline.lookup": 2, "pipeline.reserve": 3, "pipeline.persist": 4, "pipeline.publish": 5, "pipeline.project": 6}; }
    data: [@pipeline]; format: @shared.technical;
    // None of the seven nodes has place.at. Change visible detail and re-render.
}
view ports_first "1 / Move connection points before moving boxes" {
    legend { keys: {"ports.r0": 1, "ports.r1": 2, "ports.r2": 3, "ports.r3": 4}; }
    data: [@ports]; format: @shared.technical; layout: @shared.grid_seed;
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
    place @ports.n0 { at: [0px, 0px]; size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @ports.n1 { at: [340px, 0px]; size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @ports.n2 { at: [680px, 0px]; size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @ports.n3 { at: [0px, 230px]; size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @ports.n4 { at: [340px, 230px]; size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @ports.n5 { at: [680px, 230px]; size: [240px, 130px]; }
}
view move_unpinned "2 / Move unpinned nodes after connection-point trials" {
    legend { keys: {"movement.r0": 1, "movement.r1": 2, "movement.r2": 3, "movement.r3": 4}; }
    data: [@movement]; format: @shared.technical; layout: @shared.grid_seed;
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
    place @movement.n0 { size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @movement.n1 { size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @movement.n2 { size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @movement.n3 { size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @movement.n4 { size: [240px, 130px]; }
    place @movement.n5 { size: [240px, 130px]; }
    // Side constraints remain east/west; offsets on those sides are movable.
    route @movement.r0 { source_side: east; target_side: west; }
    route @movement.r1 { source_side: east; target_side: west; }
    route @movement.r2 { source_side: east; target_side: west; }
    route @movement.r3 { source_side: east; target_side: west; }
}
view pinned_crossing "3 / Short pinned routes with explicit nonconnection marks" {
    legend { keys: {"locked.horizontal": 1, "locked.vertical": 2}; }
    data: [@locked]; format: @shared.technical;
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
    place @locked.left { at: [0px, 220px]; size: [220px, 100px]; }
    place @locked.right { at: [1000px, 220px]; size: [220px, 100px]; }
    place @locked.top { at: [500px, 0px]; size: [220px, 100px]; }
    place @locked.bottom { at: [500px, 500px]; size: [220px, 100px]; }
    route @locked.horizontal { source_side: east; target_side: west; x_source_fraction: 0.5; x_target_fraction: 0.5; via: [[450px, 270px], [850px, 270px]]; }
    route @locked.vertical { source_side: south; target_side: north; x_source_fraction: 0.5; x_target_fraction: 0.5; via: [[610px, 170px], [610px, 440px]]; }
}
view obstacle "Named field endpoints / route around an unrelated box" {
    legend { keys: {"blockers.a_c": 1}; }
    data: [@blockers]; format: @shared.technical; layout: @shared.grid_seed;
    publication { size: content; fit: none; }
    place @blockers.a { at: [0px, 0px]; size: [240px, 150px]; }
    place @blockers.b { at: [350px, 0px]; size: [240px, 150px]; }
    place @blockers.c { at: [700px, 0px]; size: [240px, 150px]; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.live.pinned-patterns";
// One shared model, six placement patterns. Only place.at locks a position.
// Synthetic planning diagram, not a running integration architecture.
data network {
    object hub "Integration hub" { kind: application; fields { field request_id; field schema_version; } }
    object store "Transaction store" { kind: table; fields { field transaction_id; field occurred_at; field status; } }
    object client "Client application" { kind: application; }
    object orders "Order service" { kind: application; fields { field order_id; } }
    object inventory "Inventory" { kind: table; fields { field item_id; field quantity; } }
    object production "Production control" { kind: application; }
    object events "Event channel" { kind: topic; }
    object history "Historical projection" { kind: table; workload: [olap]; role: derived; fields { field valid_from; field recorded_from; } }
    object audit "Audit monitor" { kind: application; }
    object note "Review note" { kind: note; description: "Layout does not establish timing, ownership, or authorization."; }
    relation submit "Submit request" @client -> @hub { kind: flow; }
    relation route "Dispatch order" @hub -> @orders { kind: flow; }
    relation reserve "Check availability" @orders -> @inventory { kind: depends; }
    relation plan "Production request" @orders -> @production { kind: flow; }
    relation persist "Store transaction" @hub -> @store { kind: flow; }
    relation publish "Publish outbox" @store -> @events { kind: flow; }
    relation history_projection "Build history" @events -> @history { kind: flow; }
    relation monitor "Observe event" @events -> @audit { kind: flow; }
    relation document "Review design" @note -> @hub { kind: note; }
}
format patterns {
    style day;
    layout grid { algorithm: fit_grid; center: pins; gap: 80px; routing: curved; }
    layout circle { algorithm: circular; center: pins; gap: 80px; routing: curved; }
    layout rings { algorithm: radial; center: pins; gap: 80px; routing: curved; }
    layout hierarchy { algorithm: layered; center: pins; gap: 80px; }
    layout breadth { algorithm: spanning_tree; center: pins; gap: 80px; routing: curved; }
    layout force { algorithm: organic; center: pins; gap: 80px; routing: curved; }
    display detail { maturity: none; }
    legend key { mode: numbers; width: 330px; keys: {"network.submit":1,"network.route":2,"network.reserve":3,"network.plan":4,"network.persist":5,"network.publish":6,"network.history_projection":7,"network.monitor":8,"network.document":9}; }
    publication page { size: content; fit: none; }
    bundle shared { style: @day; layout: @circle; display: @detail; legend: @key; publication: @page; }
}
view circular "Circular / two fixed pins" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared;
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
}
view fit_grid "Fit to grid / around two pins" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared; layout: @patterns.grid;
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
}
view radial "Radial / graph-distance rings" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared; layout: @patterns.rings;
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
}
view layered "Hierarchical / directed layers" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared; layout: @patterns.hierarchy;
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
}
view tree "Tree / breadth levels from fixed pins" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared; layout: @patterns.breadth;
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
}
view organic "Organic / movable neighbours, fixed core" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared; layout: @patterns.force;
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
}
view single_pin "One pin / circular neighbours" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared;
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { size: [270px, 170px]; }
}
view no_pins "No pins / deterministic radial root" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared; layout: @patterns.rings;
    // The centre is an automatic drawing root, not a new semantic root.
}
view paused "Pause placement / retain the current scene" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared;
    layout { auto_place: false; }
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    // On first render a seed is needed; the live component then retains it.
}
view sketch_night "Same anchored circle / hand-drawn night" {
    data: [@network]; format: @patterns.shared;
    style { look: handDrawn; theme: night; }
    place @network.hub { at: [580px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
    place @network.store { at: [930px, 400px]; size: [270px, 170px]; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "ddn.live.routing-lab";
// This is a diagram, not an executing order processing application.
data model {
    object intake "Order entry" { kind: application; role: "UI + client library"; }
    object validation "Validate and reserve" { kind: activity; role: "Checks + inventory hold"; }
    object orders "Accepted orders" { kind: table; workload: [oltp];
        fields { field order_id { key: primary; } field customer_id; field accepted_at; }
    }
    object publish "Publish order event" { kind: topic; role: "Transactional outbox consumer"; }
    relation submit "Submit proposed order" @intake -> @validation { kind: flow; }
    relation accept "Persist an accepted order" @validation -> @orders { kind: flow; }
    relation event "Publish order-accepted event" @orders -> @publish { kind: flow; }
}
format shared {
    style engineering;
    layout routes { algorithm: manual; routing: orthogonal; crossings: gap; }
    display detailed { maturity: none; }
    publication web { width: 2040px; height: 740px; }
    legend key { mode: numbers; width: 350px; keys: { "model.submit": 1, "model.accept": 2, "model.event": 3 }; }
    bundle technical { style: @engineering; layout: @routes; display: @detailed; publication: @web; legend: @key; }
}
view diagram "Order acceptance / illustration" {
    data: [@model]; format: @shared.technical;
    place @model.intake { at: [0px, 0px]; size: [290px, 170px]; }
    place @model.validation { at: [420px, 240px]; size: [300px, 170px]; }
    place @model.orders { at: [850px, 0px]; size: [310px, 190px]; }
    place @model.publish { at: [1290px, 240px]; size: [290px, 170px]; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "meridian.procurement.review";

// One synthetic procurement model, reused by graph, matrix and time projections.
data process {
    object start "Purchase request" { kind: "flow.start"; }
    object capture "Capture requested items" { kind: "flow.io"; }
    object approve "Approval granted?" { kind: "flow.decision"; }
    object order "Issue purchase order" {
        kind: "flow.process";
        x_record: { start: "2026-01-05", end: "2026-01-07", status: "Complete" };
    }
    object receive "Receive and inspect" {
        kind: "flow.process";
        x_record: { start: "2026-01-08", end: "2026-01-12", status: "Complete" };
    }
    object invoice "Matched supplier invoice" { kind: "flow.document"; }
    object post "Post authorized liability" {
        kind: "flow.subprocess";
        x_record: { start: "2026-01-13", end: "2026-01-16", status: "Planned" };
    }
    object reject "Return for correction" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object close "Request closed" { kind: "flow.end"; }
    relation p01 "Request" @start -> @capture { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p02 "Submit" @capture -> @approve { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p03 "Approved" @approve -> @order { kind: "flow.next"; x_diagram: { branch: "approved" }; }
    relation p04 "Rejected" @approve -> @reject { kind: "flow.next"; x_diagram: { branch: "rejected" }; }
    relation p05 "Receive" @order -> @receive { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p06 "Match" @receive -> @invoice { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p07 "Authorize" @invoice -> @post { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p08 "Complete" @post -> @close { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p09 "Notify requester" @reject -> @close { kind: "flow.next"; }
}
data roles {
    object buyer "Buyer" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object manager "Purchasing manager" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object warehouse "Warehouse supervisor" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object controller "Financial controller" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
}
data responsibilities {
    relation order_r "Prepare order" @process.order -> @roles.buyer { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation order_a "Approve purchase" @process.order -> @roles.manager { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"A"}; }
    relation receive_r "Accept goods" @process.receive -> @roles.warehouse { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation receive_a "Own acceptance" @process.receive -> @roles.manager { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"A"}; }
    relation post_r "Prepare posting" @process.post -> @roles.buyer { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation post_c "Provide receipt evidence" @process.post -> @roles.warehouse { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"C"}; }
    relation post_a "Own financial effect" @process.post -> @roles.controller { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"A"}; }
}
data schedule {
    relation order_before_receive "Order precedes receipt" @process.order -> @process.receive { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation receive_before_post "Receipt precedes posting" @process.receive -> @process.post { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
}
data schema {
    object supplier "Supplier" { kind: entity; fields { field supplier_id { key: primary; } field name; } }
    object po "Purchase order" { kind: entity; fields { field order_id { key: primary; } field approved_on; field total; } }
    object receipt "Goods receipt" { kind: entity; fields { field receipt_id { key: primary; } field received_on; } }
    relation supplied_by "Placed with" @po -> @supplier { kind: assoc; }
    relation receipts_for "Fulfils" @receipt -> @po { kind: assoc; }
}
data access {
    relation access_po "Create and read orders" @process.order -> @schema.po { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"CR"}; }
    relation access_supplier "Read suppliers" @process.order -> @schema.supplier { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation access_receipt "Create receipts" @process.receive -> @schema.receipt { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"C"}; }
    relation access_match "Read receipts" @process.post -> @schema.receipt { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation access_post "Read and update orders" @process.post -> @schema.po { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"RU"}; }
}
data dfd {
    object supplier "Supplier" { kind: "dfd.external"; }
    object match "Match invoice" { kind: "dfd.process"; x_diagram: {number:"1.0",owner:"Accounts payable"}; }
    object receipts "Accepted receipts" { kind: "dfd.store"; x_diagram: {number:"D1"}; }
    object post "Post payable" { kind: "dfd.process"; x_diagram: {number:"2.0",owner:"Financial control"}; }
    object ledger "Payables ledger" { kind: "dfd.store"; x_diagram: {number:"D2"}; }
    object treasury "Treasury" { kind: "dfd.external"; }
    relation a "Invoice" @supplier -> @match { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation b "Receipt evidence" @receipts -> @match { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation c "Matched obligation" @match -> @post { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation d "Authorized posting" @post -> @ledger { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation e "Payment request" @post -> @treasury { kind: "dfd.data"; }
}
data classes {
    object order "PurchaseOrder" {
        kind: "uml.class";
        fields {
            field id "id: OrderIdentifier" { x_member: {kind:"attribute",visibility:"private"}; }
            field total "total: Money" { x_member: {kind:"attribute",visibility:"private"}; }
            field approve "approve(actor): Decision" { x_member: {kind:"operation",visibility:"public"}; }
            field cancel "cancel(reason): void" { x_member: {kind:"operation",visibility:"public"}; }
        }
    }
    object audited "AuditedRecord" { kind: "uml.class"; fields {field version "version: Integer" { x_member:{kind:"attribute",visibility:"protected"}; }} }
    object repo "OrderRepository" { kind: "uml.interface"; fields {field save "save(order): Result" {x_member:{kind:"operation",visibility:"public",abstract:true};}} }
    object adapter "SqlOrderRepository" { kind: "uml.class"; fields {field save "save(order): Result" {x_member:{kind:"operation",visibility:"public"};}} }
    object component "Purchasing service" { kind: "uml.component"; }
    object package "Procurement" { kind: "uml.package"; }
    relation base "Generalizes to" @order -> @audited { kind: "uml.generalization"; }
    relation realization "Implements" @adapter -> @repo { kind: "uml.realization"; }
    relation uses "Persists" @component -> @repo { kind: "uml.dependency"; }
    relation dep "Depends on" @package -> @component { kind: "uml.dependency"; }
}
data usecases {
    object buyer "Buyer" { kind: "uml.actor"; }
    object create "Create purchase order" { kind: "uml.usecase"; }
    object validate "Validate supplier" { kind: "uml.usecase"; }
    object expedite "Expedite delivery" { kind: "uml.usecase"; }
    relation uses "Participates" @buyer -> @create { kind: "uml.uses"; }
    relation include "«include»" @create -> @validate { kind: "uml.include"; }
    relation extend "«extend»" @expedite -> @create { kind: "uml.extend"; }
}
data requirements {
    object approval "Authorized purchasing" { kind: "req.requirement"; x_diagram: {code:"REQ-01",text:"A purchase order must be approved by an authorized actor before issue."}; }
    object matching "Evidence-backed posting" { kind: "req.requirement"; x_diagram: {code:"REQ-02",text:"Posting requires matched receipt and invoice evidence at an approved cutoff."}; }
    object service "Purchasing command service" { kind: "req.implementation"; }
    object test "Reject unapproved order" { kind: "req.test"; }
    relation sat "Satisfies" @service -> @approval { kind: "req.satisfies"; }
    relation verify "Verifies" @test -> @approval { kind: "req.verifies"; }
    relation derive "Derived from" @matching -> @approval { kind: "req.derives"; }
}

data facts {
    object m1 "Jan observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Jan", "date": "2026-01-01", "value": 420, "cost": 270, "count": 8, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m2 "Feb observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Feb", "date": "2026-02-01", "value": 570, "cost": 320, "count": 10, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m3 "Mar observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Mar", "date": "2026-03-01", "value": 510, "cost": 350, "count": 9, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m4 "Apr observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Apr", "date": "2026-04-01", "value": 690, "cost": 390, "count": 12, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m5 "May observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "May", "date": "2026-05-01", "value": 810, "cost": 460, "count": 15, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m6 "Jun observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Jun", "date": "2026-06-01", "value": 750, "cost": 480, "count": 14, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
}
data rules {
    object rule1 "Rule 1" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "supplier inactive", "action": "Reject with supplier status message", "priority": 1}; }
    object rule2 "Rule 2" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "approval absent", "action": "Request authorized approval", "priority": 2}; }
    object rule3 "Rule 3" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "quantity exceeds tolerance", "action": "Hold for matching review", "priority": 3}; }
    object rule4 "Rule 4" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "all guards pass", "action": "Post with immutable evidence reference", "priority": 4}; }
}
data notes {
    object supplier "SUPPLIERS" { kind: note; description: "Approved suppliers provide invoice and delivery evidence."; }
    object inputs "INPUTS" { kind: note; description: "Purchase authorization, item quantities and expected receipt."; }
    object process "PROCESS" { kind: note; description: "Issue order; receive goods; match invoice; post liability."; }
    object outputs "OUTPUTS" { kind: note; description: "Accepted receipt, approved obligation and audit reference."; }
    object customers "CUSTOMERS" { kind: note; description: "Warehouse, accounts payable and the treasury team."; }
    object strength "STRENGTHS" { kind: note; description: "Shared identifiers connect acceptance evidence to accounting."; }
    object weakness "WEAKNESSES" { kind: note; description: "Supplier outages can delay acknowledgement and matching."; }
    object opportunity "OPPORTUNITIES" { kind: note; description: "Publish purpose-scoped events for reconciliation."; }
    object threat "THREATS" { kind: note; description: "Duplicate delivery, stale approval and unknown payment outcomes."; }
    object journey "ACTOR EXPERIENCE" { kind: note; description: "Clear validation feedback and an actionable recovery path."; }
    object verification "VERIFY" { kind: note; description: "Reconcile quantities and values at a named source cutoff."; }
    object review "REVIEW NOTE" { kind: note; description: "This sample is a diagram/contract demonstration, not an implemented purchasing application."; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "meridian.procurement.views";
import "./model.ddn" as m;
import "./formats.ddn" as f;

view flowchart "01 / Purchasing control flow" {
    data: [@m.process];
    format: @f.shared.common;
    projection { kind:graph;profile:"flow.basic@1"; }

}

view responsibility_graph "02 / Shared responsibility assignments" {
    data: [@m.process, @m.roles, @m.responsibilities];
    format: @f.shared.common;
    projection { kind:graph;profile:"ddn@1"; }
    select: [@m.process.order, @m.process.receive, @m.process.post, @m.roles.buyer, @m.roles.manager, @m.roles.warehouse, @m.roles.controller];

}

view raci "03 / Model-derived RACI" {
    data: [@m.process, @m.roles, @m.responsibilities];
    format: @f.shared.common;

}

view sipoc "24 / SIPOC from shared notes" {
    data: [@m.notes];
    format: @f.shared.common;
    projection { kind:panels;profile:"panels.basic@1";columns:5;width:1650px;panels:[{id:"supplier",title:"SUPPLIER",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.supplier]}, {id:"inputs",title:"INPUTS",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.inputs]}, {id:"process",title:"PROCESS",row:0,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.process]}, {id:"outputs",title:"OUTPUTS",row:0,column:3,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.outputs]}, {id:"customers",title:"CUSTOMERS",row:0,column:4,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.customers]}]; }

}

view journey "25 / Service journey with spanning panels" {
    data: [@m.notes];
    format: @f.shared.common;
    projection { kind:panels;profile:"panels.basic@1";columns:3;panels:[{id:"input",title:"INPUT AND EXPECTATION",row:0,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.inputs]}, {id:"p",title:"PROCESS",row:0,column:1,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.process]}, {id:"out",title:"OUTPUT",row:0,column:2,rowspan:1,colspan:1,items:[@m.notes.outputs]}, {id:"actor",title:"ACTOR EXPERIENCE",row:1,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:3,items:[@m.notes.journey]}, {id:"verify",title:"VERIFICATION AND REVIEW",row:2,column:0,rowspan:1,colspan:3,items:[@m.notes.verification, @m.notes.review]}]; }

}

view matrix_general "26 / General relationship matrix" {
    data: [@m.process, @m.roles, @m.responsibilities];
    format: @f.shared.common;
    projection { kind:matrix;profile:"matrix.relations@1";rows:[@m.process.order, @m.process.receive, @m.process.post];columns:[@m.roles.buyer, @m.roles.manager, @m.roles.warehouse, @m.roles.controller];relation:"analysis.assignment";value:"name"; }

}

view shape_atlas "27 / Composable semantic silhouettes" {
    data: [@m.process, @m.usecases, @m.classes, @m.dfd];
    format: @f.shared.common;
    projection { kind:graph;profile:"ddn@1"; }
    select: [@m.process.start, @m.process.capture, @m.process.approve, @m.process.order, @m.process.invoice, @m.process.post, @m.usecases.buyer, @m.usecases.create, @m.classes.package, @m.classes.component, @m.dfd.match, @m.dfd.receipts];
    layout {algorithm:grid;columns:3;gap:120px;row_gap:100px;}
    display {relations:none;}

}

    select: [@meridian.procurement.review.process.start, @meridian.procurement.review.process.capture, @meridian.procurement.review.process.approve, @meridian.procurement.review.process.order, @meridian.procurement.review.process.invoice, @meridian.procurement.review.process.post, @meridian.procurement.review.usecases.buyer, @meridian.procurement.review.usecases.create, @meridian.procurement.review.classes.package, @meridian.procurement.review.classes.component, @meridian.procurement.review.dfd.match, @meridian.procurement.review.dfd.receipts];
    layout {algorithm:grid;columns:3;gap:120px;row_gap:100px;}
    display {relations:none;}

}

module "meridian.procurement.formats";
format shared {
    style standard;
    layout logical {algorithm: layered;gap:140px;row_gap:130px;}
    display readable {kind: none;badges:none;maturity:none;}
    publication screen {size:content;fit:none;}
    legend key {placement:none;}
    bundle common {style:@standard;layout:@logical;display:@readable;publication:@screen;legend:@key;}
}

module "meridian.procurement.review";
// One synthetic procurement model, reused by graph, matrix and time projections.
data process {
    object start "Purchase request" { kind: "flow.start"; }
    object capture "Capture requested items" { kind: "flow.io"; }
    object approve "Approval granted?" { kind: "flow.decision"; }
    object order "Issue purchase order" {
        kind: "flow.process";
        x_record: { start: "2026-01-05", end: "2026-01-07", status: "Complete" };
    }
    object receive "Receive and inspect" {
        kind: "flow.process";
        x_record: { start: "2026-01-08", end: "2026-01-12", status: "Complete" };
    }
    object invoice "Matched supplier invoice" { kind: "flow.document"; }
    object post "Post authorized liability" {
        kind: "flow.subprocess";
        x_record: { start: "2026-01-13", end: "2026-01-16", status: "Planned" };
    }
    object reject "Return for correction" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object close "Request closed" { kind: "flow.end"; }
    relation p01 "Request" @start -> @capture { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p02 "Submit" @capture -> @approve { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p03 "Approved" @approve -> @order { kind: "flow.next"; x_diagram: { branch: "approved" }; }
    relation p04 "Rejected" @approve -> @reject { kind: "flow.next"; x_diagram: { branch: "rejected" }; }
    relation p05 "Receive" @order -> @receive { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p06 "Match" @receive -> @invoice { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p07 "Authorize" @invoice -> @post { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p08 "Complete" @post -> @close { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation p09 "Notify requester" @reject -> @close { kind: "flow.next"; }
}
data roles {
    object buyer "Buyer" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object manager "Purchasing manager" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object warehouse "Warehouse supervisor" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
    object controller "Financial controller" { kind: "analysis.role"; }
}
data responsibilities {
    relation order_r "Prepare order" @process.order -> @roles.buyer { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation order_a "Approve purchase" @process.order -> @roles.manager { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"A"}; }
    relation receive_r "Accept goods" @process.receive -> @roles.warehouse { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation receive_a "Own acceptance" @process.receive -> @roles.manager { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"A"}; }
    relation post_r "Prepare posting" @process.post -> @roles.buyer { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation post_c "Provide receipt evidence" @process.post -> @roles.warehouse { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"C"}; }
    relation post_a "Own financial effect" @process.post -> @roles.controller { kind: "analysis.assignment"; x_assignment: {code:"A"}; }
}
data schedule {
    relation order_before_receive "Order precedes receipt" @process.order -> @process.receive { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
    relation receive_before_post "Receipt precedes posting" @process.receive -> @process.post { kind: "analysis.precedes"; }
}
data schema {
    object supplier "Supplier" { kind: entity; fields { field supplier_id { key: primary; } field name; } }
    object po "Purchase order" { kind: entity; fields { field order_id { key: primary; } field approved_on; field total; } }
    object receipt "Goods receipt" { kind: entity; fields { field receipt_id { key: primary; } field received_on; } }
    relation supplied_by "Placed with" @po -> @supplier { kind: assoc; }
    relation receipts_for "Fulfils" @receipt -> @po { kind: assoc; }
}
data access {
    relation access_po "Create and read orders" @process.order -> @schema.po { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"CR"}; }
    relation access_supplier "Read suppliers" @process.order -> @schema.supplier { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation access_receipt "Create receipts" @process.receive -> @schema.receipt { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"C"}; }
    relation access_match "Read receipts" @process.post -> @schema.receipt { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"R"}; }
    relation access_post "Read and update orders" @process.post -> @schema.po { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: {code:"RU"}; }
}
data dfd {
    object supplier "Supplier" { kind: "dfd.external"; }
    object match "Match invoice" { kind: "dfd.process"; x_diagram: {number:"1.0",owner:"Accounts payable"}; }
    object receipts "Accepted receipts" { kind: "dfd.store"; x_diagram: {number:"D1"}; }
    object post "Post payable" { kind: "dfd.process"; x_diagram: {number:"2.0",owner:"Financial control"}; }
    object ledger "Payables ledger" { kind: "dfd.store"; x_diagram: {number:"D2"}; }
    object treasury "Treasury" { kind: "dfd.external"; }
    relation a "Invoice" @supplier -> @match { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation b "Receipt evidence" @receipts -> @match { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation c "Matched obligation" @match -> @post { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation d "Authorized posting" @post -> @ledger { kind: "dfd.data"; }
    relation e "Payment request" @post -> @treasury { kind: "dfd.data"; }
}
data classes {
    object order "PurchaseOrder" {
        kind: "uml.class";
        fields {
            field id "id: OrderIdentifier" { x_member: {kind:"attribute",visibility:"private"}; }
            field total "total: Money" { x_member: {kind:"attribute",visibility:"private"}; }
            field approve "approve(actor): Decision" { x_member: {kind:"operation",visibility:"public"}; }
            field cancel "cancel(reason): void" { x_member: {kind:"operation",visibility:"public"}; }
        }
    }
    object audited "AuditedRecord" { kind: "uml.class"; fields {field version "version: Integer" { x_member:{kind:"attribute",visibility:"protected"}; }} }
    object repo "OrderRepository" { kind: "uml.interface"; fields {field save "save(order): Result" {x_member:{kind:"operation",visibility:"public",abstract:true};}} }
    object adapter "SqlOrderRepository" { kind: "uml.class"; fields {field save "save(order): Result" {x_member:{kind:"operation",visibility:"public"};}} }
    object component "Purchasing service" { kind: "uml.component"; }
    object package "Procurement" { kind: "uml.package"; }
    relation base "Generalizes to" @order -> @audited { kind: "uml.generalization"; }
    relation realization "Implements" @adapter -> @repo { kind: "uml.realization"; }
    relation uses "Persists" @component -> @repo { kind: "uml.dependency"; }
    relation dep "Depends on" @package -> @component { kind: "uml.dependency"; }
}
data usecases {
    object buyer "Buyer" { kind: "uml.actor"; }
    object create "Create purchase order" { kind: "uml.usecase"; }
    object validate "Validate supplier" { kind: "uml.usecase"; }
    object expedite "Expedite delivery" { kind: "uml.usecase"; }
    relation uses "Participates" @buyer -> @create { kind: "uml.uses"; }
    relation include "«include»" @create -> @validate { kind: "uml.include"; }
    relation extend "«extend»" @expedite -> @create { kind: "uml.extend"; }
}
data requirements {
    object approval "Authorized purchasing" { kind: "req.requirement"; x_diagram: {code:"REQ-01",text:"A purchase order must be approved by an authorized actor before issue."}; }
    object matching "Evidence-backed posting" { kind: "req.requirement"; x_diagram: {code:"REQ-02",text:"Posting requires matched receipt and invoice evidence at an approved cutoff."}; }
    object service "Purchasing command service" { kind: "req.implementation"; }
    object test "Reject unapproved order" { kind: "req.test"; }
    relation sat "Satisfies" @service -> @approval { kind: "req.satisfies"; }
    relation verify "Verifies" @test -> @approval { kind: "req.verifies"; }
    relation derive "Derived from" @matching -> @approval { kind: "req.derives"; }
}

data facts {
    object m1 "Jan observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Jan", "date": "2026-01-01", "value": 420, "cost": 270, "count": 8, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m2 "Feb observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Feb", "date": "2026-02-01", "value": 570, "cost": 320, "count": 10, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m3 "Mar observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Mar", "date": "2026-03-01", "value": 510, "cost": 350, "count": 9, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m4 "Apr observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Apr", "date": "2026-04-01", "value": 690, "cost": 390, "count": 12, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m5 "May observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "May", "date": "2026-05-01", "value": 810, "cost": 460, "count": 15, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
    object m6 "Jun observation" { kind: record; x_record: {"month": "Jun", "date": "2026-06-01", "value": 750, "cost": 480, "count": 14, "unit": "CAD", "description": "Synthetic monthly procurement value"}; }
}
data rules {
    object rule1 "Rule 1" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "supplier inactive", "action": "Reject with supplier status message", "priority": 1}; }
    object rule2 "Rule 2" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "approval absent", "action": "Request authorized approval", "priority": 2}; }
    object rule3 "Rule 3" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "quantity exceeds tolerance", "action": "Hold for matching review", "priority": 3}; }
    object rule4 "Rule 4" { kind: record; x_record: {"condition": "all guards pass", "action": "Post with immutable evidence reference", "priority": 4}; }
}
data notes {
    object supplier "SUPPLIERS" { kind: note; description: "Approved suppliers provide invoice and delivery evidence."; }
    object inputs "INPUTS" { kind: note; description: "Purchase authorization, item quantities and expected receipt."; }
    object process "PROCESS" { kind: note; description: "Issue order; receive goods; match invoice; post liability."; }
    object outputs "OUTPUTS" { kind: note; description: "Accepted receipt, approved obligation and audit reference."; }
    object customers "CUSTOMERS" { kind: note; description: "Warehouse, accounts payable and the treasury team."; }
    object strength "STRENGTHS" { kind: note; description: "Shared identifiers connect acceptance evidence to accounting."; }
    object weakness "WEAKNESSES" { kind: note; description: "Supplier outages can delay acknowledgement and matching."; }
    object opportunity "OPPORTUNITIES" { kind: note; description: "Publish purpose-scoped events for reconciliation."; }
    object threat "THREATS" { kind: note; description: "Duplicate delivery, stale approval and unknown payment outcomes."; }
    object journey "ACTOR EXPERIENCE" { kind: note; description: "Clear validation feedback and an actionable recovery path."; }
    object verification "VERIFY" { kind: note; description: "Reconcile quantities and values at a named source cutoff."; }
    object review "REVIEW NOTE" { kind: note; description: "This sample is a diagram/contract demonstration, not an implemented purchasing application."; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "meridian.quality.notations";

data chen {
    object order "Order" { kind: "entity"; fields { field order_id { x_chen:{key:true}; } field address { x_chen:{composite:true}; fields { field street; field city; } } field tags { x_chen:{multivalued:true}; } field calculated_total { x_chen:{derived:true}; } } }
    object line "Order line" { kind: "entity"; x_chen: { "weak": true, "owner": @order }; fields { field line_no { x_chen:{partial_key:true}; } field quantity; } }
    relation contains "Identifies line" @order -> @line { kind: "assoc"; x_chen: { "identifying": true, "owner": @order, "weak": @line, "from": { "min": 1, "max": 1 }, "to": { "min": 0, "max": "many" } }; }
}

data usecases {
    object subject "Quality control system" { kind: "uml.subject"; }
    object inspector "Inspector" { kind: "uml.actor"; }
    object senior "Senior inspector" { kind: "uml.actor"; }
    object review "Review lot" { kind: "uml.usecase"; x_usecase: { "subjects": [@subject], "extension_points": ["before disposition"] }; }
    object record "Record evidence" { kind: "uml.usecase"; x_usecase: { "subjects": [@subject] }; }
    object escalate "Escalate issue" { kind: "uml.usecase"; x_usecase: { "subjects": [@subject] }; }
    relation uses "Reviews" @inspector -> @review { kind: "uml.uses"; }
    relation generalizes "Specializes" @senior -> @inspector { kind: "uml.generalization"; }
    relation includes "Includes evidence" @review -> @record { kind: "uml.include"; }
    relation extends "Escalates when necessary" @escalate -> @review { kind: "uml.extend"; x_usecase: { "extension_point": "before disposition", "condition": "The declared review policy requires escalation." }; }
}

data flow {
    object start "Inspection received" { kind: "flow.start"; }
    object inspect "Inspect evidence" { kind: "flow.process"; }
    object decision "Within limits?" { kind: "flow.decision"; }
    object store "Record audit outcome" { kind: "flow.storage"; }
    object reject "Nonconformance record" { kind: "flow.document"; }
    object out "To closure sheet" { kind: "flow.offpage"; x_continuation: { "key": "QC-A", "side": "out", "page": "2" }; }
    object in "From inspection sheet" { kind: "flow.offpage"; x_continuation: { "key": "QC-A", "side": "in", "page": "1" }; }
    object connector "A" { kind: "flow.connector"; }
    object end "Review complete" { kind: "flow.end"; }
    object note "Keep evidence independent of approvals" { kind: "flow.annotation"; }
    relation a "Receive" @start -> @inspect { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation b "Evaluate" @inspect -> @decision { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation pass "Accept" @decision -> @store { kind: "flow.next"; x_diagram: { "branch": "accept" }; }
    relation fail "Reject" @decision -> @reject { kind: "flow.next"; x_diagram: { "branch": "reject" }; }
    relation c "Continue" @store -> @out { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation d "Continue" @reject -> @out { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation e "Resume" @in -> @connector { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation f "Close" @connector -> @end { kind: "flow.next"; }
    relation continuation "QC-A continuation" @out -> @in { kind: "flow.continues"; }
    relation annotation "Evidence note" @note -> @store { kind: "flow.annotation"; }
}

ddn "0.5";
module "meridian.quality.review";

// Shared synthetic observations and requirements. No remote service is called.

data causes {
    object effect "Dimensional inspection failures" { kind: "quality.effect"; }
    object cat0 "Equipment" { kind: "quality.category"; }
    relation cat_to_effect0 "Possible cause category" @cat0 -> @effect { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object cat1 "Materials" { kind: "quality.category"; }
    relation cat_to_effect1 "Possible cause category" @cat1 -> @effect { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object cat2 "Method" { kind: "quality.category"; }
    relation cat_to_effect2 "Possible cause category" @cat2 -> @effect { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object cat3 "Measurement" { kind: "quality.category"; }
    relation cat_to_effect3 "Possible cause category" @cat3 -> @effect { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object cat4 "People" { kind: "quality.category"; }
    relation cat_to_effect4 "Possible cause category" @cat4 -> @effect { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object cat5 "Environment" { kind: "quality.category"; }
    relation cat_to_effect5 "Possible cause category" @cat5 -> @effect { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object calibration "Calibration drift" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_calibration "Possible contributing cause" @calibration -> @cat0 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object wear "Tool wear" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_wear "Possible contributing cause" @wear -> @cat0 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object variation "Incoming material variation" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_variation "Possible contributing cause" @variation -> @cat1 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object storage "Humidity during storage" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_storage "Possible contributing cause" @storage -> @cat1 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object setup "Setup instructions unclear" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_setup "Possible contributing cause" @setup -> @cat2 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object schedule "Calibration interval too long" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_schedule "Possible contributing cause" @schedule -> @cat2 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object gauge "Gauge repeatability" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_gauge "Possible contributing cause" @gauge -> @cat3 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object sample "Sample identification errors" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_sample "Possible contributing cause" @sample -> @cat3 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object training "Training not current" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_training "Possible contributing cause" @training -> @cat4 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object handover "Shift handover incomplete" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_handover "Possible contributing cause" @handover -> @cat4 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    object temperature "Temperature variation" { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation c_temperature "Possible contributing cause" @temperature -> @cat5 { kind: "quality.cause"; }

    relation calibration_measurement "Same cause, second appearance" @calibration -> @cat3 { kind: "quality.cause"; }
    relation schedule_calibration "Possible underlying cause" @schedule -> @calibration { kind: "quality.cause"; }
}

data responsibilities {
    object inspect "Inspect incoming lots" { kind: "analysis.task"; }
    object contain "Contain nonconforming lots" { kind: "analysis.task"; }

    relation access_inspect_lot "Data access" @inspect -> @lot { kind: "analysis.access"; x_assignment: { "code": "R" }; }

    relation score_inspect_plant_c "Supplied review score" @inspect -> @plant_c { kind: "assoc"; x_record: { "score": 8, "status": "Action" }; }

    relation score_contain_plant_b "Supplied review score" @contain -> @plant_b { kind: "assoc"; x_record: { "score": 7, "status": "Action" }; }
    relation score_contain_plant_c "Supplied review score" @contain -> @plant_c { kind: "assoc"; x_record: { "score": 4, "status": "Monitor" }; }
    relation score_correct_plant_a "Supplied review score" @correct -> @plant_a { kind: "assoc"; x_record: { "score": 0, "status": "Good" }; }
    relation score_correct_plant_b "Supplied review score" @correct -> @plant_b { kind: "assoc"; x_record: { "score": 3, "status": "Monitor" }; }
}
